future-leadership-human-ai-you.body:
## Will You Lead or Be Left Behind?

When you hear "2025," what do you see? Flying cars? Robots taking over? Maybe an AI dystopia? Let’s pump the brakes on the sci-fi. The truth is, AI isn’t here to replace us—it’s here to amplify us.

The real question isn’t whether AI will change the game, it already has. _The real question is this: Will you step up and lead, or will you get left behind? _

## AI: The Co-Pilot, Not the Pilot

I joined LinkedIn in 2006. Back then, every post felt like shouting into a void. Building real connections? Now, that was the ultimate challenge. Fast-forward 18 years later, and [AI is helping leaders](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/ai-leaders-work-smarter-connect-deeper-joshua-b-lee-m4ifc/?trackingId=5SPMfLhDTuiNFPH6rjw8BQ%3D%3D) like us cut through the noise to connect more effectively.

But here’s the thing: AI is a tool, not a replacement. It’s the co-pilot, not the pilot. You’re still in charge of the journey, but now you’ve got a sidekick who can anticipate your needs, map the best routes, and lighten the load.

The difference? The destination becomes more attainable—and the ride, smoother. Credit to Natasha Loder | The Economist Cartoonist and Health Policy Editor

## Amplified Intelligence, Not Artificial Intelligence

Think about it this way: [AI can handle the busywork](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/ai-humanity-perfect-blend-success-joshua-b-lee-vewac/?trackingId=T00luV1hQpK71UwPkh5EWg%3D%3D)—data crunching, scheduling, automating repetitive tasks. But the magic still comes from you. Your stories. Your voice. Your quirks.

Let’s take LinkedIn’s Hiring Assistant as an example. Sure, it can analyze resumes like a pro, but it’s not hiring. You still have to connect, build trust, and show candidates why they should want to work with you. That’s AI + Authenticity in action.

And the best part? AI isn’t competing with you—it’s working with you. By automating the things that bog you down, it frees you to double down on what you do best: inspiring teams, building connections, and making a difference.

### Still Think AI is Optional? Let’s Look at the Numbers

If you’re on the fence about embracing AI, these stats might change your mind:

🔵 68% of marketers are optimistic about AI’s role in their work (Kantar).

🔵 40% of global companies already use AI, and adoption rates are skyrocketing in countries like India and Singapore (Exploding Topics).

🔵 By 2030, the AI market is projected to hit $1.85 trillion, growing at an annual rate of 37%.

Ignoring AI in 2025 is like doubling down on Blockbuster while Netflix is taking over. Leaders who wait for “the right time” to adopt AI will quickly find themselves left in the dust.

## Why AI Will Never Replace Leaders

AI **can**:

✔ Save you time.

✔ Spark creativity.

✔ Scale your efforts.

But here’s what it **can’t** do:

❌ Build trust.

❌ Inspire passion in a team.

❌ Create deep, emotional connections.

The other day, my son Jayden asked, “Dad, does a computer do all your work?” That question stopped me in my tracks. The answer is simple: AI makes me better. It doesn’t replace me. It gives me time to show up fully as a leader, dad, and husband. My first-born Jayden and my wife Rachel B Lee.

This is the human advantage. No matter how advanced AI gets, it will always lack the empathy, intuition, and creativity that make us uniquely human. That’s why the best leaders will use AI not to replace their humanity but to amplify it. Credit and Artist Tim O Elliott

## Your 2025 AI Toolkit

Not sure where to start? Here are 3 tools to use AI effectively without losing your humanity:

🔵 [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/linkedin/) Hiring Assistant: Streamline recruiting so you can focus on personal connections.

🔵 [ChatGPT](https://www.linkedin.com/company/aichatgpt/) or Other Writing AIs: Generate ideas or drafts but always add your personal voice.

🔵 Customer Service AI: Automate responses and free up your team for bigger, human-focused challenges.

These tools aren’t just about saving time—they’re about reinvesting that time where it counts. Imagine freeing up hours every week to focus on mentoring your team, strategizing for the future, or simply being more present with your family. That’s the power of integrating AI into your workflows.

## The Future is Human + AI Partnerships

Leaders who thrive in 2025 won’t just use AI—they’ll use it to amplify their impact, authenticity, and relationships.

Here’s where I see things heading:

🔵 AI will become the standard across businesses, big and small.

🔵 Leaders who master AI tools will scale faster and smarter.

🔵 Trust and ethical AI practices will define the leaders people want to follow.

But it’s not enough to use AI—you need to use it intentionally. The goal isn’t to automate every task or interaction. It’s to [integrate AI](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/work-smarter-harder-3-benefits-using-ai-joshua-b-lee-qduyc/?trackingId=GhU%2B3S7HTWqQRuoNuGGTIw%3D%3D) in ways that elevate your ability to lead, inspire, and connect. Credit © Chappatte in Le Canard Enchaîné, France

### Your Leadership Challenge

As we close out the year, I want you to ask yourself one simple question:

_How will you use AI to lead with heart in 2025? _

Maybe it’s automating repetitive tasks so you can spend more time with your family. Maybe it’s embracing AI insights to guide your team with clarity. Whatever it is, one thing is certain: no tool can replace the power of human connection.

So, what’s your plan? Make 2025 the year you use AI not to replace who you are but to amplify it.

### Quick Tips for Leading in 2025 with AI

🔵 Post Smarter: Use AI to analyze engagement trends.

🔵 Engage Authentically: Reply to comments and DMs with your unique voice.

🔵 Automate the Mundane: Let AI handle scheduling, data, and other time consuming tasks.

Don’t just watch from the sidelines. The future is happening now. Let’s lead it together.

ai-leaders-work-smarter-connect-deeper.body:
Back in 2014, when I started [StandOut Authority](https://www.linkedin.com/company/standoutauthority/), my goal was simple: help leaders bring a human touch to LinkedIn. Fast-forward to 2024, and while the tools we use have changed, the mission hasn’t. AI is the buzzword of the decade, but here’s the truth: It’s not about replacing us—it’s about amplifying what makes us great leaders.

## How AI Transforms Leadership Without Losing the Human Edge

I remember testing out AI for content creation in the early days—it felt robotic and impersonal. The breakthrough came when I found the integration: letting AI handle the routine so I could focus on building real relationships.

Here’s what I’ve learned about AI’s role in leadership:

🔵 Hyper-Personalization is the Standard: Your audience doesn’t want generic. They expect brands and leaders to understand them, anticipate their needs, and deliver tailored experiences. AI lets us do this at scale.

🔵 Ethical AI is Your Competitive Advantage: If your AI usage isn’t transparent; you risk losing trust—and trust is everything. Your customers and teams are paying attention, and ethical AI practices will define the leaders who stand out in 2025.

🔵 AI Integration is Non-Negotiable: Ignoring AI is like Blockbuster ignoring Netflix. It’s no longer optional; it’s the standard for innovation and growth.

**Case in Point:** Microsoft’s Copilot Actions is transforming workplaces by automating tedious tasks like meeting summaries and approvals. Teams get to focus on big-picture goals, not busywork. 2024 Work Trend Index Annual Report from Microsoft and LinkedIn

AI is a tool, not a replacement. Here’s what **AI CAN’T do**:

❌ Build trust with your audience or team.

❌ Inspire your people with vision and passion.

❌ Create genuine, human connections.

That’s where YOU come in. AI can help draft a LinkedIn post, but only you can infuse it with personal stories, quirks, and life lessons. At StandOut Authority, I’ve learned that while AI manages the details, my role as a leader is to show up with heart, inspire my team, and build authentic connections.

## Why AI is a Game-Changer for Leaders

AI isn’t just for the future—it’s here, reshaping how businesses operate today. According to [Exploding Topics](https://explodingtopics.com/blog/companies-using-ai), around 40% of global companies are already using AI in at least one area of their operations, and another 42% are actively exploring it. The leaders? Countries like India, the UAE, and Singapore are ahead of the curve, with adoption rates over 50%. Meanwhile, the U.S. is playing catch-up, with just 33% of businesses using AI tech. 😮Exploding Topics Report

What’s driving this push? The AI market is booming, projected to hit $1.85 trillion by 2030, growing at an insane annual rate of over 37%. Larger companies are leading the charge, with 42% of businesses with over 1,000 employees using AI, compared to 20% of smaller ones, according to the report.

And it’s not just for show—AI is getting real results where it matters most:

🔵 Customer service: 56% of companies use AI to deliver better, faster interactions.

🔵 Cybersecurity: 51% rely on AI to protect their data and prevent fraud.

🔵 Digital assistants: 47% have integrated AI-powered helpers to streamline workflows. Exploding Topics Report

The takeaway? AI is no longer a “trend”—it’s a critical part of staying competitive. The businesses winning with AI aren’t just adopting it; they’re integrating it strategically to work smarter, not harder. AI isn’t just reshaping businesses—it’s reshaping how leaders like us show up.

AI’s power doesn’t just lie in what it can do for a company; it’s about how it can transform [YOU as a leader](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/human-touch-how-ai-can-amplify-your-work-replace-joshua-b-lee-gbvlf/?trackingId=Be8Fhkt%2BSc%2ByLp7573i1Rg%3D%3D). There was a time when my to-do list felt endless. Between running StandOut Authority, being a husband to Rachel, and raising my kids, I was constantly stretched thin. Then I thought, what if AI could give me just one extra hour a day?

_Spoiler:_ It gave me more than that. And that saved time has transformed how I show up—for my family, my team, and my clients. Nothing beats quality time with my Ladyboss wife Rachel B Lee.

Here are the tools that made it happen:

🔵 [CopyandContent.AI](http://CopyandContent.AI): Quickly draft content for LinkedIn posts, newsletters, and blogs.

🔵 [OpenAI](https://www.linkedin.com/company/openai/) ChatGPT: Summarize research, generate ideas, and create scripts that save time and spark creativity.

🔵 [LinkedIn AI Tools](https://business.linkedin.com/talent-solutions/hiring-assistant?utm_source=www.theneurondaily.com&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=microsoft-turns-on-openai): Optimize your profile, analyze your audience, and elevate your personal brand.

**Here’s your December challenge:**Try just one of these tools. Free up an hour in your week, then use that time to focus on what truly matters—building real connections and creating a meaningful impact.

> AI isn’t just about saving time—it’s about reinvesting that time where it counts most.

## The Future: Human + AI Partnerships

AI isn’t here to take your job. It’s here to help you [level up](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/ai-humanity-perfect-blend-success-joshua-b-lee-vewac/?trackingId=A8mHlm7JRISV4xfiTMKxSA%3D%3D). But the leaders who thrive in 2025 won’t just adopt AI—they’ll master the art of blending technology with authenticity.

### My Predictions for 2025:

🔵 AI will become SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) for every business.

🔵 Ethical AI practices will separate trusted leaders from the rest.

🔵 Leaders who integrate AI strategically will scale faster while staying connected to their purpose.

> Innovation is no longer optional, but it’s your humanity that keeps you unforgettable.

### Your Leadership Challenge for 2025

Identify one repetitive task you can delegate to AI. Use the time saved to reconnect with your “why” or build deeper relationships. Lead with purpose, using AI as your sidekick—not your replacement.

AI isn’t here to replace you—it’s here to amplify you. Use it. Master it. Lead with it.

🚀 **Looking Ahead to 2025: Is Your LinkedIn Strategy Ready?**

As we gear up for a new year, it’s time to think bigger about how you’re showing up on LinkedIn. The platform isn’t just a professional networking tool anymore—it’s the stage where your personal brand can thrive.**The Standout Authority Experience will give you the confidence to finally get VISIBILITY and BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES without having to SPAM annd SELL people.**

That’s why the [StandOut Authority Experience On-Demand](https://standoutauthority.com/standout-authority-experience-on-demand/?vgo_ee=tuFAkWoZRDmKuE9%2B3Fy92o%2FxYZlyS7J2UFF8k4dThnb2eEwyEjXZGQzbnA%3D%3D%3AIs%2BMZ%2BFtQu%2FETO3tNSJKWDMphAXoGEcP) exists: to help leaders like you attract your ideal audience, engage authentically, and create meaningful opportunities.

2025 is about more than growth; it’s about building trust, sharing value, and turning connections into advocates. With the right approach, LinkedIn can become your most powerful asset.

mens-health-awareness-month-build-health.title: Men’s Health Awareness Month: Build a Healthier You, Build a Better Business
mens-health-awareness-month-build-health.excerpt: The Wake-Up Call: From Surviving to Thriving There was a time when I was far from thriving. I could barely climb a flight of stairs without getting winded, and my business felt just as out
mens-health-awareness-month-build-health.body:
## The Wake-Up Call: From Surviving to Thriving

There was a time when I was far from thriving. I could barely climb a flight of stairs without getting winded, and my business felt just as out of shape. I was grinding, stressed, and stuck in survival mode.

Then reality hit. According to the [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/data/vsrr/vsrr031.pdf), men have a life expectancy of just 74.8 years, compared to women at 80.2 years. That’s not just a number—it was a wake-up call. For me, it wasn’t just about living longer but living better, for myself and for the people who count on me. The turning point? Deciding to make small, [consistent changes](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_forget-balance-its-time-to-integrate-activity-7265740829133070338-KBxy?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop). Those changes became the building blocks of a healthier me and, in turn, a healthier business. The most up to date stats from the CDC.

Here’s what I learned along the way:

🔵 Small Wins Build Big Momentum: I didn’t start with marathons or heavy weights. I started small—10-minute runs, quick workouts, and building consistency.

🔵 Mental Health Fuels Every Success: Dealing with past baggage wasn't fun, but very necessary. When I addressed my [mental health](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_entrepreneur-mindset-standoutauthority-activity-7260667406853824514-sk3_?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop), it was like flipping a switch. Suddenly, I had focus, energy, and clarity I hadn’t felt in years.

🔵 What You Eat Shapes How You Lead: Nutrition isn’t just about aesthetics—it’s about respect. Eating whole, nutritious foods improved my energy, focus, and overall performance. Research backs this up: the gut-brain connection is real, and what you eat directly impacts how you think and feel.

## Health is Leadership: Show Up for the Long Haul

Being healthy isn’t about vanity metrics or gym selfies—it’s about showing up as the best version of yourself, consistently. As a dad to Jayden, Skylar, and Ava, and a husband to Rachel, I’ve realized that prioritizing my health is about more than me. It’s about being present for the milestones—first steps, big wins, and everything in between. My famiLEE means everything to me and they are my WHY.

The truth is, when you prioritize your health, you’re not just investing in yourself. You’re investing in your family, your team, and the people who look up to you.

Here’s why it matters:

🔵 Your Health Sets the Tone for Your Team: Leaders who prioritize their well-being inspire their teams to do the same. It’s a ripple effect.

🔵 Mental Clarity Drives Better Decisions: Simple practices like meditation or a 10-minute walk each day can clear your mind and keep you grounded in high-pressure moments.

🔵 Energy is Contagious: When you take care of yourself, your energy radiates outward. It boosts morale, strengthens relationships, and helps you show up as a [better leader](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_mentalhealth-standoutauthority-entrepreneurship-activity-7251955038502150145-6CLI?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop).

## What Big Businesses Can Teach Us About Health

It’s not just individuals focusing on health—some of the biggest companies in the world are stepping up. Take KPMG, for example. They launched an [Energy Check-In initiative](https://fortune.com/well/2024/03/06/kpmg-launches-well-being-initiative-workers-risk-burnout/?utm_content=c948b947-2fac-4e17-a611-9ed7c7a94758) to identify employees at risk of burnout. Their pilot program had incredible results:

77% of employees said it improved their well-being.

88% of managers found it helped them better support their teams.

> Sandy Torchia, KPMG’s Vice Chair of Talent and Culture, put it best: _“We’re corporate athletes, and we need to be both physically and mentally ready to do our job.”_

It’s a reminder that whether you’re running a Fortune 100 company, 500 company, or a solopreneur business, investing in health isn’t optional—it’s essential.

## The Intergration of Business, Health, and Family

Building a business is demanding. Add in the responsibilities of being a parent and partner, and it’s easy to let your health slip. But here’s the thing: your health is the foundation of everything else.

For me, it’s about integrating health into my daily routine. Some days, that looks like a Peloton session. Other days, it’s a walk outside with Frankie our goldendoodle, or lifting weights while chatting with Jayden. It’s not about perfection—it’s about showing up consistently. And let’s talk about mental health for a second. Meditation has helped me so much in my mental wellness journey. It’s one of the simplest ways to reset, refocus, and show up stronger in all areas of life.

For decades, men have been taught to wear their stoicism like armor—to suppress emotions, “man up,” and present an image of unshakable control. This pressure, especially in leadership and entrepreneurship, can be suffocating. But in 2024, we’re seeing progress: conversations about masculinity and men’s health are becoming more open, but there’s still a long way to go.

I’ve felt that pressure firsthand. In business, the expectation to “have it all together” can feel relentless. Suppressing emotions to fit into a mold isn’t strength—it’s a disservice to ourselves and the people we lead. True strength is about recognizing when we’re struggling and having the courage to face it head-on.

For me, the moment I started confronting my mental health was the moment my life changed. It wasn’t easy, but it was necessary. Facing the emotions I’d been bottling up didn’t just make me a better leader—it made me a better father, husband, and friend.

Here’s the reality:

💡Over 6 million men suffer from depression [annually](https://adaa.org/find-help/by-demographics/mens-mental-health), yet male depression often goes underdiagnosed.

💡More than 3 million men in the U.S. experience panic disorders, agoraphobia, or other phobias.

Men’s Health Awareness Month reminds us that health isn’t just physical—it’s emotional, mental, and relational. It’s about dismantling the outdated notion that vulnerability equals weakness.

### November: A Perfect Time for Reflection and Action

November isn’t just about turkey and pumpkin pie—it’s a prime time to set the stage for the coming year. Here’s how you can use this month to level up your health and your business:

🔵 Set Your Physical Health Goals: Start small. Block time for workouts and treat it like an important meeting.

🔵 Prioritize Your Mental Health: Take a few moments each day to reflect, meditate, or journal.

🔵 Plan for 2025: Map out your goals now, so you can hit January with clarity and confidence.

**Pro Tip:**Treat your health like your most important client. Schedule it. Show up for it. And watch how it transforms everything else. Rachel and I took some much-needed R&R during a time that was challenging, but we came back better.

## Your Health is Your Legacy

You know, there was a point in my life where everything looked perfect on the outside—multiple companies, big wins, and the kind of success people dream about. But behind the scenes? I was falling apart. I was in my 30s, juggling way too much, and feeling completely disconnected from myself and the people around me.

To make things worse, I was going through a tough divorce. It hit me like a ton of bricks. Suddenly, all the "success" in the world couldn’t make up for the fact that I wasn’t happy, healthy, or fulfilled. I was burned out, stressed out, and just... lost.

That’s when I made a decision that scared the hell out of me. I shut it all down—every company, every project. With less than $1,000 to my name, I moved back in with my parents. Talk about a humbling moment. But honestly? It was exactly what I needed. It gave me the space to step back and figure out what really mattered—not just in business, but in life.

I realized that the way I’d been working, the way I’d been living, wasn’t sustainable. I needed to start integrating my passions, my relationships, and my work in a way that actually supported my health and happiness. That was the turning point for me, and it’s shaped everything I’ve done since then.

> I share this because I know I’m not the only one who’s felt this way. Sometimes, we get so caught up in chasing success that we forget to check in with ourselves. But trust me, if you don’t make time for your health—mental, physical, and emotional—it’ll catch up with you eventually. And when it does, it’s not pretty.
Doing what I love healthy and focused.

Men’s Health Awareness Month isn’t just about quick fixes or checking off boxes. It’s a call to action to take ownership of your health, not just for yourself but for the people and goals that matter most. When you prioritize your well-being, you’re building a foundation for sustainable success—in your business, your relationships, and your life.

So, here’s my challenge to you:

🔵 Reflect on your health—physical, mental, and emotional.

🔵 Set one actionable goal for the month.

Share your journey. Let’s inspire each other to show up stronger, every day.

#DopamineDose #MensHealth #MensMentalHealth #Leadership #Entrepreneurship #StandOutAuthority

entrepreneurship-month-lessons-purpose-c.title: Entrepreneurship Month: Lessons on Purpose, Connection, and Innovation
entrepreneurship-month-lessons-purpose-c.excerpt: November is Entrepreneurship Month, where we honor the dreamers, the doers, and the resilient warriors of the business world. Whether you’re just starting your entrepreneurial path or…
entrepreneurship-month-lessons-purpose-c.body:
November is Entrepreneurship Month, where we honor the dreamers, the doers, and the resilient warriors of the business world. Whether you’re just starting your entrepreneurial path or reflecting on years of lessons, this journey is a rollercoaster ride of wins, setbacks, and moments that define us.

In this Dopamine Dose edition, I’m diving into the lessons I’ve learned from 20+ years of experience of launching 16 companies—lessons shaped by both triumphs and mistakes. Let’s explore how innovation, resilience, and human connection drive entrepreneurial success. Plus, we’ll tackle a question on everyone’s mind: Is entrepreneurship evolving, or is it fading?

## The Golden Era of Entrepreneurship: Are We Facing a Shift?

Entrepreneurship has come a long way. From the early days of the internet boom to the excitement of Shark Tank moments, we’ve seen an entrepreneurial explosion like no other. Today, there are approximately 500 million entrepreneurs worldwide, with 31 million in the U.S. alone. It’s been an era defined by resilience, grit, and relentless innovation.

But as technology advances, some are wondering: _Is entrepreneurship evolving, or are we losing what makes it truly powerful? _

The emergence of AI and automation has added a new layer to the conversation. With AI taking over repetitive tasks and optimizing processes, some say we risk losing the very qualities—grit, creativity, and a relentless drive—that have traditionally defined the entrepreneurial spirit. The core question is this: _How do we use technology to evolve while staying true to what makes entrepreneurship meaningful? _

🔵 Entrepreneurship isn’t about shortcuts. It’s about resilience, passion, and solving problems that matter. [AI can streamline](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/ai-humanity-perfect-blend-success-joshua-b-lee-vewac/?trackingId=aShX4JqjSICgHTahZjQGUA%3D%3D), but it can’t replace the human spirit that fuels innovation. I've been on the entrepreneurial journey for 20+ years, it wasn't easy to get here, but now having AI makes it much more efficient.

For me, it’s all about integration. Imagine Tony Stark and Jarvis: humans and technology working together, not in place of one another. Real progress happens when we use tools like AI to free up our time and enhance our strengths—not replace our creativity, passion, or problem-solving skills.

## Discovering Your “Why”: The Foundation of Every Entrepreneur

Technology and tools will continue to evolve, but one thing that will always be essential in entrepreneurship is having a clear, compelling why. [When I first started, I was head-down, grinding toward profits.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/navigating-entrepreneurial-challenges-guide-turning-sht-joshua-b-lee-ld2vc/?trackingId=rGSgWPCDSKi2WXW8iA4p0w%3D%3D)But without a bigger purpose guiding my journey, I often found myself going through the motions.

That changed after a trip to Necker Island with Sir Richard Branson. Watching him build not just businesses, but communities, I learned that true success comes from having a mission that drives you beyond the numbers. This feels like ages ago, but this moment still has an impact on my entrepreneurial life.

Your why is your anchor. It’s the foundation that keeps you focused and aligned, even in uncertain times. And here’s why it matters: **First-time entrepreneurs only have an 18% chance of success.** But those who understand their purpose and align their actions with it see much higher rates of success.

**Action Step:**Reflect deeply on your “why.” Take the time to clarify your purpose:

🔵 What impact do you want to make?

🔵 How will your work contribute to something greater?

🔵 Who are you serving, and why does it matter?

When your purpose is clear, you’re not just building a business—you’re building a legacy.

## Prioritize Your Well-being: The Key to Sustainable Success

Let’s get every day[is a silent killer for entrepreneurs.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/why-balance-bullsht-how-work-through-stress-out-workplace-lee-tnbxc/?trackingId=wCW1QjDETPKuARfDGKlHtg%3D%3D)Early in my career, I thought working myself to the bone was a badge of honor. But the truth? That mindset left me drained, unproductive, and disconnected. Whether it's walking Frankie, running with my son, or being on the peloton, working out is non-negotiable.

It wasn’t until I prioritized my health, incorporating workouts on my Peloton, participating in Spartan races back in the day, or running with my son Jayden, that I realized how crucial well-being is to leadership. When your energy is high, your focus sharpens, your creativity flows, and you’re able to tackle challenges head-on.

💥 A fit body supports a sharp mind, and a sharp mind drives a successful business.

Stats to back it up: Did you know that physical activity can boost productivity by up to 21%? Entrepreneurs who prioritize their health report greater resilience and decision-making ability.

**Action Step:** Build wellness into your daily routine. Schedule time for physical activity, prioritize quality sleep, and make space for moments of mental reset. It’s not about perfection—it’s about consistency.

## The Human Connection: Building Relationships That Last

Forget vanity metrics and surface-level networking. Real success is built on authentic connections. According to Inc. Magazine, 77% of entrepreneurs say strong relationships with peers and mentors are critical to their success. Mark de Grasse has been working in branding and content creation for 20 years. He’s a friend, peer, and fellow entrepreneur. Your network is your net worth.

And yet, 55% of entrepreneurs struggle to reach their target customers. Why? Because trust takes time, and it’s earned through genuine engagement, not flashy pitches. My best partnerships and biggest opportunities have always come from real conversations, not forced sales tactics.

**Action Step:** Invest in your network. Comment thoughtfully on LinkedIn, send personal messages to check in on your connections, and show up authentically in every interaction. People work with people they trust—not just people who sell well.

## Entrepreneurship as a Team Sport: The Power of Partnership

Entrepreneurship is a wild ride, but doing it alongside Rachel? That’s a whole new level. She’s not just my wife; she’s the Chief Marketing Officer, a branding powerhouse, and the ultimate LadyBoss. When Rachel B. Lee left her corporate career to join me at StandOut Authority, she brought with her the experience, strategy, and fearless energy that’s helped take our business to new heights. My partner Rachel B Lee is the yin to my yang in all aspects of life.

Here’s what I’ve learned: _Entrepreneurship is about more than building a business. It’s about surrounding yourself with people who challenge you, push you to be better, and share your vision._Rachel’s transition from corporate America to entrepreneurship didn’t just boost our business; it redefined what’s possible when two people bring their unique strengths together.

Rachel, your leap of faith, your expertise, and your unwavering commitment to our shared vision inspire me every day. To anyone wondering if family and business can mix: Hell yes, it can. And when it works, it’s pure magic.

## AI and Entrepreneurship: A New Era of Possibilities

Let’s talk about the game-changer that is AI. At StandOut Authority, we’ve embraced AI to automate mundane tasks, supercharge our content, and analyze market trends. But we also understand that AI is a tool, not a replacement. According to Microsoft’s 2024 Work Trend Index, 90% of users say AI saves them time, and 84% feel it makes them more creative.

This perspective is echoed by experts who emphasize the importance of maintaining the human touch in the age of AI. For instance, an [article](https://www.entrepreneur.com/starting-a-business/ai-vs-a-human-touch-finding-the-right-balance-when-it/457495) from Entrepreneur highlights that while AI can handle data analysis and routine tasks, it cannot replicate genuine human connections and empathy, which are vital in building meaningful client relationships.

MIT Sloan also puts it perfectly—human creativity is what makes the magic happen. It’s the key to connecting the dots across different fields and pushing boundaries in ways AI alone just can’t. When we bring our creative spark to the table, AI becomes a powerful tool to help us build sustainable, long-term advantages.

AI is opening doors to insane levels of efficiency and innovation, but real entrepreneurial success? That still comes down to us. It’s about blending the power of tech with the irreplaceable stuff—our creativity, empathy, and ability to build real, human connections. That’s where the magic happens.

## Gen Z: The Next Wave of Entrepreneurs

As a dad to two Gen Z kids, I’ve got a front-row seat to the way this generation is reshaping entrepreneurship. They’re bold, resourceful, and unafraid to disrupt the status quo. 54% of Gen Z plan to start their own business, and 84% aim to do so within the next five years.  My daughter Skylar teaches me something new everyday.

What sets them apart? Research. They dive deep into understanding their markets, leveraging digital tools to refine their ideas. And in a world where 20% of businesses fail within the first two years, this skill is critical for long-term success. Gen Z is showing us that with the right blend of research, resilience, and relationship-building, they’re ready to take on the entrepreneurial world. My son Jayden is my oldest, and he's got a curious mindset like me.

## A Letter to Entrepreneurs

Dear Aspiring Entrepreneur,

We accept the fact that we’ve chosen a path filled with late nights, early mornings, and more risks than most people would dare to take. But we think it’s wild to ask us to define what it means to be an entrepreneur.

You see us as you want to see us: in the simplest terms, in the most convenient labels. You call us dreamers, hustlers, disrupters, or maybe even fools chasing impossible goals. But what we’ve discovered is that each one of us is much more than that.

We’re the visionaries who imagine a better world…

The builders who create something from nothing…

The risk-takers who bet on ourselves when no one else will…

The learners who fail fast and pivot faster…

And the connectors who bring people together for a common cause.

Does that answer your question?

Sincerely yours,

The Entrepreneurs' Club The Breakfast Club

If this feels familiar, it’s because we all have a bit of the Breakfast Club spirit in us. Like those iconic characters, entrepreneurs defy easy categorization. We’re complex, driven, and constantly evolving. This entrepreneurial journey isn’t about fitting into a box—it’s about breaking out of one.

## Your Journey, Your Legacy

Entrepreneurship isn’t just a career path; it’s a lifestyle, a mindset, and a commitment to growth—both personally and professionally. It’s about embracing change while staying anchored to your purpose. 20 years, 16 companies, and $500M+ in ad spend later, here’s what I’ve learned: success isn’t about chasing trends—it’s about building connections that last.Podcast ready.

I recently sat down with Adam Levinter on the Entrepreneurs Exposed podcast to talk about:

✅ The early days of online marketing

advancing-social-selling-linkedin-how-bu.body:
## Social Selling Isn’t Dead—It Just Got Real

Ever feel like the digital world is changing faster than you can keep up? Well, get focused famiLEE, because social selling is back and bigger than ever. Forget the outdated scripts and slimy 🤢 sales tactics—this is about building real, human connections that drive [growth opportunities.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/ditch-lead-chase-3-days-magnetic-client-attraction-linkedin-lee-tcn1f/?trackingId=X0pBYq9PR4%2BCkkJPqA3sCg%3D%3D)

Social selling has evolved into an art of trust and authenticity. It’s no longer just about “closing deals.” It’s about crafting genuine relationships that open doors. @Harvard Business Review [calls it essential](https://hbr.org/2024/06/the-new-rules-of-marketing-across-channels), but here’s the reality: if you want to thrive in this landscape, it’s time to embrace the new rules of social selling.

My Dopamine Dose Definition: Social Selling: Make real connections, not cold pitches—turn conversations into growth opportunities.

Whether you’re a veteran at this game or new to building a brand, I’ve got you covered with insights to level up your LinkedIn strategy. Ready to turn connections into impact? Let’s dive in.

## How Fortune 500 Leaders Are Nailing Social Selling

When it comes to using LinkedIn for social selling, [Microsoft](https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft/) and [Adobe](https://www.linkedin.com/company/adobe/) are setting a powerful example. They get that social selling is about connecting with people, adding real value, and building relationships that actually mean something.

### Microsoft: Earning Trust by Showing Up

Microsoft’s approach to LinkedIn is more than just showing off its latest products. They’ve got everyone involved—from top execs to sales teams—sharing insights and starting conversations that resonate with their audience. Whether it’s talking about tech trends, company culture, or real-life challenges, Microsoft doesn’t use LinkedIn to “sell” but to connect. They focus on creating real dialogue, which makes them not just a go-to tech leader but a trusted voice. This isn’t about quick sales; it’s about making lasting connections that go beyond one transaction.

If you aren't already following Microsoft on LinkedIn, be sure to make it a priority this week.

## Adobe: Adding Value Through Personal Engagement

Adobe goes all in on LinkedIn, empowering its teams with tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator to target the right audience while still keeping the focus human. Their team members regularly post about topics their audience cares about—things like digital marketing and innovation in design.

Adobe’s approach isn’t just about putting out content; it’s about sharing value and being relevant. By encouraging their people to engage genuinely, Adobe keeps its brand top of mind in a way that feels real, making them a standout resource for decision-makers.

These companies get it: social selling isn’t about pitching to everyone. It’s about showing up authentically, having conversations that matter, and letting connections drive the results. Take a note from their playbook—make LinkedIn the place where you build trust, not just business.

A great example of how Adobe does social selling right.

## The Real Strength of Social Selling

Social selling isn’t about blasting out products; it’s about building genuine R-E-L-A-T-I-O-N-S-H-I-P-S. But let me be clear—if you’re posting twice a year on holidays and leaving generic comments, that won’t cut it. You’ve got to show up with purpose and a plan. So, before you even think of selling, start here:

### 1. Optimize Your Profile

Your [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/10-ways-optimize-your-linkedin-profile-success-2024-joshua-b-lee-k9ntc/?trackingId=DJnGjJV8ReKB%2BnXnJs%2BT6g%3D%3D) is your digital storefront. It needs to be polished, genuine, and undeniably you. Forget being humble here—show off your expertise and story. Make your profile say, “This is who I am, and I’m here to make a difference.”

Optimize your profile, it's your digital handshake.

### 2. Engage Authentically

Forget the hard sell. Share insights, join conversations, and engage meaningfully. Think of every comment as a way to put some humanity into this digital world. It’s about creating real connections that turn into real results.

### 3. Use LinkedIn’s Tools

Let’s cut the bullsh*t–EVERY social platform is literally designed to keep you ON it for AS long AS possible. LinkedIn is no different—so use it! LinkedIn LIVE, newsletters, articles, interactive posts—each tool can help you stay top-of-mind and showcase your value.

## Building Genuine Connections: The Real Currency

In a digital age obsessed with automation, [authenticity is your superpower.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/beyond-numbers-game-cultivating-high-value-connections-joshua-b-lee-8nmwc/?trackingId=VPBMe%2BneSu%2Bke9QKKYS03g%3D%3D) Just being real can take you a long way. People crave connection, not pitches. Here’s what I do to keep it real on LinkedIn:

🔵 **Be Human:**Ditch the corporate talk. Share your personality, your quirks, and your passion. People connect with people—not brands or scripts.

🔵 **Share Your Story:** Whether it’s a quick anecdote about how I embarrassed myself in front of the kids last week or a case study on helping a client’s launch, personal stories resonate more than any ad or cold pitch ever could.

🔵 **Listen and Learn:** Social selling is a two-way street. Engage with your network’s content and insights. Some of my best ideas (and partnerships!) have come from a casual comment or a conversation about top notch places to grab sushi. Never underestimate where a genuine connection can lead.

## Staying Ahead of the Curve

Social selling is an evolving art, and the only way to stay relevant is to adapt, or you’ll be left behind. Staying ahead doesn’t mean jumping on every new tool blindly—it means being intentional about learning and implementing what aligns with your goals.

### Invest in Learning

Stay updated on the latest LinkedIn features and best practices. Knowledge here isn’t just power—it’s also profit. If the updates feel overwhelming, try learning one new feature each month.

### Experiment and Adapt

Try new approaches and content types. Not everything will work, but if you hit on something your audience loves, double down on it. If it flops, learn from it and move forward.

### Measure Success

Track what works and what doesn’t. In social selling, what gets measured gets optimized. Data-driven decisions will help you refine your strategy and make the impact you’re aiming for.

**Remember:** _Social selling is about more than sales. It’s about community and impact._ So, get out there and start building connections that matter. And when you need a hit of dopamine to keep you motivated, you know I’m here to serve it up.

I sat down with [Thomas Helfrich](https://www.linkedin.com/in/thomashelfrich?miniProfileUrn=urn%3Ali%3Afs_miniProfile%3AACoAAAGOfVEBWgldhLmFyii51qvvI5RpCSUcAoU) on his podcast 🎙️ [Never Been Promoted](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/never-been-promoted/id1702007147). We got real about what it means to show up online, not just as a professional, but as a human. Thomas and I unpacked my journey—from early days in real estate to helping brands like MySpace make their first moves in social media advertising.

Episode 106 - Shortcuts to Mastering LinkedIn Personal Branding

We dug into some personal resets, the kind that shift everything, and why building a brand isn’t about making noise—it’s about connecting on a genuine level.

This episode covers some of the highs, lows, and lessons from my journey, plus some practical insights on why LinkedIn is a goldmine for anyone serious about creating a personal brand that resonates. Big thanks to Thomas for inviting me to dive deep on this one. I’d love for you to check it out and let me know what resonates! 🎧

📢[Catch the full episode here!](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/shortcuts-to-mastering-linkedin-personal-branding-with/id1702007147?i=1000669334221)

from-stress-success-4-ways-build-mental-.body:
## The Blurry Line Between Leadership and Mental Health

Is there anything more important than your sanity?

Not in my world.

Mental health has always been core to who I am. And let’s be real—especially for us men, we’ve been taught to push emotions aside, to always show up with that “brave face.” But here’s the truth (speaking from personal experience)—mental health is not just another ✅ box on your wellness checklist. It’s foundational to everything—your business, your leadership, and your relationships.

Reality check: **New data shows that for almost**[70% of people](https://www.forbes.com/sites/tracybrower/2023/01/29/managers-have-major-impact-on-mental-health-how-to-lead-for-wellbeing/)**, their manager has a bigger impact on their mental health than even their therapist or doctor.** That’s wild. And get this—it’s equal to the impact their partner has. Yeah, you read that right. So, if you're [leading a team](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/why-balance-bullsht-how-work-through-stress-out-workplace-lee-tnbxc/?trackingId=%2BWod0VY2R9WyKVEEgoYIDA%3D%3D), this is one of those stats that should hit hard.

> You’ve got serious influence over your team's well-being, and it’s time to own that responsibility.

Rachel and I are not just married—we run this business together, and we’ve learned that mental health has to come first, both in life and in business. It’s our non-negotiable.

In this edition of Dopamine Dose, we’re going to break down the connection between stress, mental health, and leadership. I’ll share how I navigated it (and still am), and most importantly, how you can master it too.

## My Journey: From Burnout to Breakthrough

Between being a dad (three times over!) and running multiple businesses, I’ve seen my share of highs and lows. Early on, the hustle of entrepreneurship nearly drowned out my personal life. I was chasing success so hard that I almost lost sight of the most important thing: me. And here’s the kicker—mental well-being isn’t just a “nice to have”; it’s a game-changer. Once I prioritized it, I shifted from focusing on those vanity metrics to looking at the bigger picture—well-being AND success. And that was my breakthrough.

_Did you know that_[19.1 million U.S. adults](https://www.forbes.com/health/mind/mental-health-statistics/)_struggle with anxiety disorders? That’s not a small number, and more than 3 million men experience panic disorder or other phobias._

The State of Organizations 2023 McKinsey & Company Report

### Stress and Leadership: The Silent Burden

Let’s be honest—leadership gets all the glory, but no one really talks about the stress that comes with it. Behind every strategic decision and “big win” is a constant companion: stress. It haunted me for years. And it wasn’t until I hit that breaking point that I realized something crucial—mental health isn’t just beneficial. It’s essential for success.

Stress is not a one-off visitor; it’s there lurking in the shadows. So the question is, how do we manage it and still perform at our best?

## 4 Ways to Build Mental Resilience in Business

Here’s how I do it:

**1. Guard Your Boundaries Like Your Life Depends on It**

Your personal time is non-negotiable. Trust me. In a world that glorifies the hustle, set hard boundaries to protect your personal time and recharge. This applies to business AND family. Say “no” when you need to. Why? Because the first person you owe something to is YOU.

**2. Leverage Tech for Mindfulness**

Yes, I’m all about AI and tech to speed things up. But sometimes, we need to slowwww down. Apps like [Calm](https://www.linkedin.com/company/calm-com/) and [Headspace](https://www.linkedin.com/company/headspace-meditation-limited/) phave been game-changers for me, helping me ground my day before the chaos hits. You don’t need hours—5 minutes of mindfulness can set you up for a dopamine-filled day.

**3. Catch Burnout Early**

Burnout sneaks up when you least expect it. The key? Tune into your body and mind. If you’re feeling the heat, it’s time to step back before the fire becomes a blaze. In entrepreneurship, you’re always putting out fires, but don’t forget the one burning inside you.

**4. Move Your Body**

Movement has been a game-changer for me. I used to crush mud runs, and honestly, they did more for my mental reset than any meeting ever could. These days, it’s morning walks with Ava in her stroller, workouts with Rachel, or runs with my two older kids. Whatever it is, getting my body moving helps remind me that life’s bigger than the next deal. Trust me, your inner child will love it.

This feels like a lifetime ago, but I do remember it helping me in that season of life.

## Empathetic Leadership: The Key to Long-Term Success

At [StandOut Authority](https://www.linkedin.com/company/standoutauthority/) , [Rachel B. Lee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/therachelblee?miniProfileUrn=urn%3Ali%3Afs_miniProfile%3AACoAAATthuAB-Gy4FMm8KnvDftaFczqyPAUOIsI) and I believe empathy is the most powerful leadership tool you can have. It’s not just about knowing your team—it’s about _truly understanding_ them. When people feel supported, they bring their best. [A recent Forbes study](https://www.forbes.com/sites/tracybrower/2023/01/29/managers-have-major-impact-on-mental-health-how-to-lead-for-wellbeing/) found that**when employees are in a good mental space, 63% are more committed, and 80% feel energized.**

Think about that—empathy doesn’t just feel right; it _drives results_. Leadership today isn’t about exercising authority; it’s about listening, communicating with compassion, and staying flexible. We’ve entered the era of _human leadership_, where empathy isn’t a "nice-to-have" skill—it’s a game-changer for success. In fact, [research shows](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/people-and-organizational-performance/our-insights/the-state-of-organizations-2023) that employees with highly empathetic managers are 3x more committed to their work compared to those with less empathetic leaders.

Leaders who understand their team's emotions can fuel innovation, improve communication, and help navigate stress during times of change. When people feel safe and heard, they perform better. And this isn’t just about retention—it’s about creating a culture where everyone _thrives_.

### Living a Purpose-Driven Life as a Dad and a Leader

As a dad to three amazing kids, two of whom are neurodivergent, empathy isn’t just a leadership tool—it’s my lifeline. Parenting kids who’ve faced deep emotional battles has made me realize that empathy goes beyond the office. It’s about showing up fully for them. When your child is hurting, it’s not about fixing the problem like a business challenge—it’s about being present, listening, and helping them feel understood.

Balancing leadership and fatherhood has taught me that being an empathetic leader at home fuels the way I lead in business. Creating a space where people (whether team members or my kids) feel supported is key to thriving, in life and in business.   My two oldest kids, they are older now, and we are navigating the teen years.

So, how do we help our kids not just heal but thrive? How do we make sure their mental health struggles today don’t turn into scars they carry as adults?

👉 Embrace the Imperfect: We’re all human, and showing our kids that it’s okay to have off days is crucial. It teaches them resilience and the importance of emotional honesty.

👉 Create a Safe Space: In our house, we talk about feelings—a lot. It’s about making sure they know it’s safe to express themselves, whether they’re flying high or feeling low.

👉 Prioritize Real Breaks: Sometimes, we just sit together, no screens, no distractions, just us, breathing the same air, being there for each other. It’s in these quiet moments that we find our strength to regroup.

Mental health isn’t just another topic—it’s the backbone of how we love, lead, and look after each other. I’m laying it out here because if you’re going through something similar, I want you to know you’re not alone. Purpose isn’t just a motivational buzzword. It’s the compass that guides you through life’s messiest moments.

For me, reconnecting with my purpose transformed both my personal and professional life. So, what’s your ‘why’? Find it, nurture it, and let it drive you through the tough times.

I get it—talking about mental health, [especially as men](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/leading-purpose-6-tips-men-21st-century-joshua-b-lee-wbdnf/?trackingId=39Lpr0RZSlK93A5DAW4I5w%3D%3D), can feel like walking on eggshells. But opening up has been one of the most freeing things I’ve ever done. It strengthened my leadership, deepened my relationships, and added a layer of authenticity to my life that I didn’t even know was missing.

So, are you ready to join me? Let’s make mental health a core part of leadership—not an afterthought.

_____________________________________________________________________________________________________

I had a blast chatting with [Samantha Riley](https://www.linkedin.com/in/samriley?miniProfileUrn=urn%3Ali%3Afs_miniProfile%3AACoAAAiMQaIBl04VmUkSrg5s5r2yEl2p-eYl8kE) on the **Influence By Design** podcast! We dove deep into how LinkedIn has transformed into a goldmine for building real, human-to-human connections and driving business growth. 🧠

💥 We talked about everything from why quality content is key to leveraging LinkedIn's power to boost your authority. If you’re ready to unlock LinkedIn’s full potential, this episode is a must-listen! 🎙️[Check it out](https://youtu.be/yaX8ZRFnElY?si=xjPvlsZPirVZbas4) and discover how to make LinkedIn work for _you_.

The digital world is moving fast and that means there's a ton of opportunity out there. We're talking real, tangible growth on LinkedIn, not some fluffy, feel-good bullshit. If you want to get in on the action, you need a damn good game plan. LinkedIn is a gold mine if you know how to work it.

In this Dopamine Dose edition, I’m giving you a laser focused breakdown of how to aim and hit these growth opportunities to take your business success to a new level.

## Stop Chasing Leads, Start Attracting Clients with a Powerful LinkedIn Strategy

LinkedIn is more than just a professional network. But you already knew this right!?

🔵 You already know it's your ultimate stage to showcase your business journey.

🔵 You already know that engaging in meaningful H2H (human-to-human) connection is a breath of fresh air amongst all the sleazy marketing tactics.

🔵 And you already know that you don’t want to be another grimy marketer screaming BUY BUY BUY from the top of your internet lungs.

This reminds me of my early entrepreneurship career days when I dipped my toes into the world of internet marketing and was instantly 🤢 repulsed by all the slimy messages floating around (I still am). In the early 2000s, I was the guy behind the scenes, catapulting giants like MySpace, Yahoo, and Google into the stratosphere. I’ve learned a lot since then.

Back then, networking meant countless events, cold handshakes, and shared business cards. But today, especially since Covid flipped the business script, the ‘how you market yourself’ looks different…. if you want people to **actually** notice you.  Me, circa 2015. In the early 2000s, I was the guy behind the scenes, catapulting giants like MySpace, Yahoo, and Google into the stratosphere. I’ve learned a lot since then.

That’s why most business owners have recognized if they’re not online, their business basically doesn’t exist. But with so many platforms to choose from, where should you focus your attention? Which one will land you the genuine, high-quality growth opportunities?

**THE ANSWER? LINKEDIN.**

I’m not saying that because I’m the Dopamine Dealer of LinkedIn or a LinkedIn Top Voice or the CEO, Founder, and Co-Owner of StandOut Authority, a LinkedIn marketing agency with a mission to help business owners and execs land their dream clients.

I say this because numbers don’t lie:

🔵 LinkedIn has over 1 billion members worldwide. (that’s 1 billion opportunities)

🔵 40% of LinkedIn visitors organically engage with a page every week. (that could be your page)

🔵 LinkedIn is the #1 most trusted platform by brands. (utilize it)

So why not jump on this and use LinkedIn to your advantage to reach the right people in the right place? Gain a competitive edge with our [3-day challenge and strategy.](https://www.linkedin.com/events/3daychallenge-optimizeyourlinke7235356640340758528/) Learn the key tactics that will move you towards becoming a thought leader in your market and grow your business.Source: Hootsuite Social Trends Survey 2024

### Here's 3 things to focus on for growth opportunities:

### 1. Understanding Your Audience

Like any good relationship, to be successful on LinkedIn, you need to understand your audience. What are their goals? What are their pain points? [89% of marketers agree](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/linkedin-statistics/#advertising-marketing) that LinkedIn is effective for generating growth opportunities, so it’s important to identify who you’re speaking to. Once you know who your ideal customer is, tailor your message to their specific pain points and goals. Make it clear that you understand their problems and have the solution. That's how you become THE go-to expert in their eyes!

But let's face it, that can be a real time suck. It's like trying to decipher ancient hieroglyphics, right? [AI is your secret weapon](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/human-touch-how-ai-can-amplify-your-work-replace-joshua-b-lee-gbvlf/?trackingId=wIkaEGlSRuiYtBNzzypcCQ%3D%3D) – it’ll help you get a deep dive into your audience under 10 minutes, and I'm telling you, it's a game-changer. Trust me, your brain will thank you for it.

Sourced by NP Digital

### 2. Crafting Your Personal Brand

Your personal brand is your professional footprint. It goes with you wherever you go so learn to craft a compelling brand statement and LinkedIn headline. Take note from Fortune 500 companies that excel in marketing like The Coca-Cola Company—[94%](https://techreport.com/statistics/finance-marketing/branding-statistics/) of the world’s population identifies the famous logo. Coca-Cola’s success lies in its consistent brand messaging, focusing on happiness, refreshment, and shared experiences. This translates to your personal brand by emphasizing your values, unique strengths, and how you connect with others.Source: Coca-Cola

Here are 5 key elements that shape your personal brand

✅ Identity and Values: This is your core, your "why." It's about what you believe in and what you want to be known for. Keep it real and genuine to you.

✅ Unique Selling Proposition (USP): What makes you, well, you? It's that special something that sets you apart from the crowd.

✅ Voice and Messaging: How you talk, write, and connect with others. Keep it consistent and let your personality shine through in every interaction.

✅ Online Presence: Your digital stage! From LinkedIn to webinars, this is where you show up and show off. Make sure it reflects the real you.

✅ Reputation and Credibility: It's all about how others see you. Build it by delivering value and staying true to your word.

By focusing on your identity, unique strengths, consistent voice, online presence, and reputation, you can create a brand as memorable as Coca-Cola's iconic logo.

### 3. Maximizing Your LinkedIn Profile

Your profile is your one chance to make a fire first impression. Why? Because how you present yourself tells your audience a lot about who you are. Plus, the internet has SO much going on, that optimizing your profile is the key to visibility and engagement. I started at 0 followers and connections, no loyal following, and no one subscribed to my newsletter. I joined LinkedIn in January of 2006, and to date in September of 2024, I have 43,410 followers, and 19,841 subscribers to my Dopamine Dose Newsletter.

[To attract growth opportunities](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/one-simple-strategy-took-my-linkedin-from-zero-hero-joshua-b-lee-4ycqc/?trackingId=WcnZ%2BNGdQtOBVPH17W02%2Bw%3D%3D) and position yourself as an authority in your field I recommend you start with these 3 basic things that often get neglected:

🔵 A professional headshot or image to use as your profile photo so you give off professional and trustworthy vibes when someone checks out your profile.

🔵 Crafting an engaging and informative About Section that will draw in your audience and make them feel confident that you are the expert they're looking for.

🔵 Perfecting your headline so it’s clear what you do and what audience you serve to any profile visitor.

Of course, there’s more but these are my absolute must-haves. You’re reading this just in time to join me for our 3-day challenge that will help you with all of the above.

## Join the Authority Builders 3-Day Challenge

If you nodded along while reading this newsletter, Rachel B. Lee branding ladyboss, along with the power squad from [CopyandContent.AI](http://CopyandContent.AI) Matthew Hagberg and Jim Edwards has teamed up to help you do all that in **JUST 3 DAYS.**

You’ll learn how to use AI to analyze your audience, create your personal brand and whip your LinkedIn profile into tip-top shape from the guys who LITERALLY created the AI tool from [CopyandContent.AI](http://CopyandContent.AI)

AND they’ll even give you a BONUS subscription trial at no cost after the 3-day challenge so you can play around with it and start creating content that’s higher quality. And do it in a split second instead of wasting hours staring at a blank page.
