coca-cola-snoop-dogg-you-insights-buildi.title: Coca-Cola, Snoop Dogg, and You: Insights into Building a Powerful Personal Brand on LinkedIn
coca-cola-snoop-dogg-you-insights-buildi.excerpt: PERSONAL B-R-A-N-D-I-N-G is all I’ve been hearing lately. And no, it’s not because I am married to LinkedIn Top Voice LadyBoss Rachel B. Lee 😍 This month, I’m getting serious with y’all…
coca-cola-snoop-dogg-you-insights-buildi.body:
PERSONAL B-R-A-N-D-I-N-G is all I’ve been hearing lately. And no, it’s not because I am married to LinkedIn Top Voice LadyBoss Rachel B. Lee 😍

This month, I’m getting serious with y’all about why you’re missing a MASSIVE opportunity if you’re not using your LinkedIn to your personal brand's advantage. Let’s jump into how to stand out, engage, and grow on LinkedIn.

## No More Sweaty Handshakes: Mastering the Art of Online Networking

Think of LinkedIn as your personal TED Talk stage, where you can share your journey and engage in genuine H2H (human-to-human) interactions. When I started my career, I had to attend countless networking events, shake a bazillion sweaty hands, and hand out physical business cards to grow my network. THANKFULLY, today, LinkedIn offers that same opportunity with just your fingertips. It lets you showcase your [unique narrative](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_dominate-q4-5-kick-ass-content-activity-7237821866147520512-TNcx?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) and connect with like-minded professionals globally.

Now, you might be thinking…” Awesome, Josh–that means I can hide behind my keyboard and not speak to anyone ever again…”  Don't be fooled! The same social skills are essential for [all types of networking:](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_standoutauthority-marketing-socialmedia-activity-7232023681214902272-SFek?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) hanging out with friends, in-person networking, and online networking. Think of it this way: just like any relationship, [building genuine connections](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_linkedin-dopaminedose-contentmarketing-activity-7234197992512086016-FIsV?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) with someone you've never met in person requires effort.

> _The same is true online, where algorithms track your activity and reward you for engaging with others.  _

First, you'll need to stand out to get noticed. How do you do that? Easy! Get your profile properly set up and create your personal brand strategy. **This is all about working out your values, who you serve (your audience), what message you want to convey, and then showing up (consistent posting). **

## Coca-Cola: A Masterclass in Building a Brand That Transforms Time

You know, The Coca-Cola Company is a real masterclass in branding. They've managed to stay relevant and top-of-mind for generations, which is no small feat! They've built an iconic brand that resonates with people across cultures and time. It's a testament to their understanding of what makes a brand truly enduring. It's like they've cracked the code to building a business that transcends time. I think that's something any business leader can learn from. ( Image Credit: Coca Cola)

### Coca-Cola And the Power of Consistent Branding

Coca-Cola has been a branding powerhouse for decades, and their 2023 and [2024 strategies](https://www.simplilearn.com/tutorials/marketing-case-studies-tutorial/coca-cola-marketing-strategy) continue to set the standard. Committed to emotional connection, Coca-Cola leverages consistent messaging and iconic branding to maintain its leading position. Their campaigns focus on happiness, sharing, and celebration, appealing to a global audience while respecting local cultures. (Image Credit: Coca Cola)

In recent years, Coca-Cola has focused on sustainability, aligning its brand with environmental consciousness. This move resonates well with millennials and Gen Z. This strategic shift strengthens its market position and ensures it remains relevant in a rapidly changing world. And it’s working! According to the Coca-Cola Quarterly Performance Review, the company's [net revenue grew by 3% to $11.3 billion](https://www.coca-colacompany.com/media-center/coca-cola-reports-first-quarter-2024-results) in the first quarter of 2024.

### What We Can Learn

The importance of authenticity, storytelling, and strategic engagement. Here’s how you can apply these insights to your own brand:

🔴 Authenticity is Key: Stay true to your values, as Coca-Cola does, to create a branding narrative that resonates.

🔴 Storytelling Wins: Like Coca-Cola, use storytelling to connect with your audience emotionally.

🔴 Strategic Engagement: Engage meaningfully with your audience, leveraging LinkedIn tools to enhance visibility.

## Snoop Dogg with A Masterclass in Authentic Branding
(Image Credit: Snoop Dogg’s LinkedIn)

You know [SnoopDogg](https://www.linkedin.com/in/snoopdogg/), right? The legendary rapper who’s always been unapologetically himself? Well, his storytelling skills are just as legendary. He’s got this knack for capturing attention and adding depth to his personal brand, making him a captivating figure that's gone viral across social media, even racking up views on LinkedIn!  Remember seeing him at the Paris 2024 Olympics? Snoop's a chameleon, adapting to different situations while staying true to himself. This kind of versatility solidified his brand as a respected authority, showing us all the power of strategic storytelling in reaching a wide range of audiences.

But did you catch him on LinkedIn? Snoop’s journey from "gangsta" rapper to business mogul is a powerful testament to the magic of authentic branding. Take his partnership with the smokeless BBQ pit brand, Solo Stove, it's a perfect example of how storytelling and authenticity can elevate a personal brand and create narratives that resonate with a broad audience.

## The Smokeless BBQ Pit Collaboration

When Snoop announced he was "done with smoke," and going "smokeless," the internet went wild! It turned out it was all a clever [marketing campaign](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/solo-stove_gosmokeless-activity-7132433877314240513-7_Fd?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) with Solo Stove. The whole thing was brilliant, proving how authentic storytelling can make a brand soar. Snoop brings his signature realness and quirks to the collaboration, making the partnership relatable and engaging. He's not afraid to be himself, and that genuine connection with his fans is what makes him so successful, even in the business world. (Image Credit: Solo Stove)

Did you know LinkedIn [users who engage with posts in the first hour see significantly higher visibility](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/understanding-how-linkedin-algorithm-works-guide-your-april-federico-lpnve/)? Or that content rich in storytelling and personal insights tends to receive waaaayyyy more engagement? These stats cement the power of being present and purposeful on the platform.

So, if I could encourage you to explore some extra LinkedIn tools that will give your personal brand that stand out authority like Coca-Cola and Snoop Dogg, I would say turn your attention to:

**🔵 LinkedIn Live:**Host live sessions to engage your audience in real-time.

**🔵 Behind-the-Scenes Content:**[Share glimpses](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_socialmedia-authenticity-standoutauthority-activity-7226969184721649664-AhIS?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) into your professional life to humanize your brand.

**🔵 Profile Optimization:** Use storytelling to make your profile reflect your journey and expertise.

Remember, your story is powerful—share it authentically and watch your LinkedIn personal brand stand out! But where do you start? 📢 Introducing: [The Authority Builders Challenge](https://www.linkedin.com/events/3daychallenge-optimizeyourlinke7235356640340758528/)!

Over 3 action-packed days, you'll dive deep into crafting a personal brand and LinkedIn profile that captivates, connects, and converts. Join @Rachel B. Lee and me, along with experts Jim Edwards and Matthew Hagberg from [CopyandContent.AI](http://CopyandContent.AI), for interactive sessions packed with insights into:

💡 Day 1: Defining your target audience using AI to attract ideal clients.

💡 Day 2: Building a personal brand statement and headline that captures your unique value.

💡 Day 3: Optimizing your LinkedIn profile for SEO and maximum visibility.

Join us September 30th to October 2nd, 2024, and learn what it takes to turn your ‘meh’ LinkedIn account into a shining, glowing client magnet 🧲 [Click here to secure your spot today](https://www.linkedin.com/events/3daychallenge-optimizeyourlinke7235356640340758528/) and wake up to opportunities landing in your inbox!

P.S. It’s completely FREE to sign up. And NO, there’s NO SECRET CATCHES. We just want to share the LinkedIn dopamine with y’all.

from-resume-ecostystem-part-2-strategies.title: From Resume to Ecosystem Part 2: Strategies for Success in the AI Era
from-resume-ecostystem-part-2-strategies.excerpt: As we keep shifting, how we connect and grow on LinkedIn changes. As a reminder, this Dopamine Dose is part two of a two-part newsletter series in which I’m taking concepts and lessons from
from-resume-ecostystem-part-2-strategies.body:
As we keep shifting, how we connect and grow on LinkedIn changes. As a reminder, this Dopamine Dose is part two of a two-part newsletter series in which I’m taking concepts and lessons from my book ‘Balance Is Bullsh*t’, which was published in 2017, and adapting best practices to the evolved LinkedIn landscape.

It feels like ages ago since my book was published.

If you haven’t read [part one](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/from-resume-ecosystem-part-1-connecting-building-growing-lee-a51xc/?trackingId=oY%2BsukP7RvqJ5ZtCmcW9nA%3D%3D), no worries, you can catch up on it later, let’s jump into this Dopamine Dose.

## Master LinkedIn’s Powerful Tools

### LinkedIn Live

When I wrote Balance Is Bullsh*t, the LinkedIn Live feature wasn’t available yet. “LinkedIn Events” launched in May 2020 to help organizations connect in real-time with their audience. Imagine how much community building got flipped on its head when you could jump online and speak to and with your audience at any moment.

Sourced by LinkedIn LIVE Best Practices Guide

LinkedIn Live offers that kind of real-time interaction, and it’s a game-changer. [According to LinkedIn](https://business.linkedin.com/content/dam/me/business/en-us/amp/marketing-solutions/images/lms-linkedin-live/best-practices/pdf/linkedin-live-best-practices-v03.05-interactive.pdf), live videos receive _7x more reactions and 24x_more comments than regular videos. Hosting webinars, Q&A sessions, or live events can significantly increase your engagement and visibility, making your online presence stand out.

## LinkedIn Analytics and Insights

Learn how to read the data! It may feel overwhelming to look at all the numbers, stats, impressions, reach, etc. But regularly reviewing your LinkedIn analytics means receiving quick answers that are worth learning. Understanding what content resonates with your audience allows you to refine your strategy. According to LinkedIn's 2024 analytics report, users who regularly review their metrics are 40% more successful in reaching their engagement goals.

[Data from 2024](https://www.socialinsider.io/blog/linkedin-benchmarks/) shows that, on average, users increased their posting frequency by 10% to an average number of 18 posts per month. I know from experience this is favored by the LinkedIn algorithm (if it’s value-packed content). You can use your insights to build your impact and keep your [content strategy](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/one-simple-strategy-took-my-linkedin-from-zero-hero-joshua-b-lee-4ycqc/?trackingId=H8F2vQduTXivBLGDEA1e2g%3D%3D) on point. It’s all about working smarter, not harder.

### Here’s a breakdown of those LinkedIn metrics:

🔵 Engagement Rate: This shows how many people actually did something with your posts, like liking, commenting, or sharing. It's calculated by looking at how many people interacted divided by how many saw it.

🔵 Median Likes, Comments, Shares: This tells you the middle number of likes, comments, and shares you get. It's like saying, "Most of my posts get about this many interactions."

🔵 Posts per Month: This simply tells you how often you're posting on LinkedIn.

🔵 Impressions Rate: This tells you what percentage of your followers have actually seen your posts. It's calculated by looking at how many people saw your posts compared to your total number of followers.

So, what's the takeaway? Use your insights to refine your LinkedIn strategy and stay ahead of the curve.

## Embrace AI Integration

In 2017, big data and AI learning was slowly kicking off to the public, but it was nowhere near the level it is now. AI isn’t the future anymore. It’s the reality of today. So many people ask me, “Josh, are we getting replaced by AI?” My short answer is always: NO; but – a person who uses AI the right way and leverages it as a career skill, can replace us in the long run.

> Here’s the good news though: AI tools are only as good as the people using them.

My philosophy is to embrace technology, and that’s why I spend a lot of time experimenting with AI tools. I’m proud to admit that, yes, I incorporate the latest AI tools into my workflow and into the workflow of my company StandOut Authority . It helps my team easily build LinkedIn profiles and content and create detailed personas that genuinely sound like the clients we write for.

I tell my team - to think of it as having a personal assistant, making it simpler to maintain an active and engaging presence. If used correctly, [AI streamlines processes](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/ai-humanity-perfect-blend-success-joshua-b-lee-vewac/?trackingId=e%2FfNR6ZVSRab%2BO7KZlWLaA%3D%3D) in your business with ease and efficiency and frees up valuable time to focus on what truly matters—connecting with the audience. LinkedIn is not just a professional network; it’s a revolution in connecting, sharing, and growing.

 By embracing its full potential, you can build a powerful personal brand, create meaningful connections, and drive real business results.

##  Authenticity and Connection

In this age of AI and automation, where algorithms can connect us in an instant, it's easy to forget the human need for connection. LinkedIn, for all its technological prowess, has become a powerful reminder of our shared humanity. My journey on this platform has been a testament to this. It’s more than just a professional networking site; it's a space where I've rekindled old connections and forged new partnerships, finding solace in the shared values and experiences of like-minded individuals.

Rachel and I understand this human connection deeply. We value authentic storytelling, sharing the triumphs and struggles of entrepreneurship without the polished façade. We know that the journey isn't always smooth sailing; it's about navigating the ups and downs, making sacrifices, and making tough choices.

Seeing other entrepreneurs share their own journeys, unfiltered and real, reminds me that I'm not alone. It's a reminder that even in the age of AI, human connection remains a priority. This sense of community, built on shared understanding and genuine engagement, is invaluable. LinkedIn has become a crucial part of my strategy, allowing me to build a strong network, position myself as a thought leader, and reach a broader audience.

But beyond the numbers and algorithms, it's the human element that truly resonates. The platform allows me to connect with potential collaborators and learn from the experiences of others, reminding me that even amidst the challenges, we're all in this together, connected by a shared human experience.

I recently had the pleasure of diving into this with Robert (Bob) Bianchi, ESQ., NREMT , and David Bruno, Esq. of the The Bianchi Law Group, LLC on a LinkedIn LIVE session.  We broke down the power of human connection in our digital age and why being real is the key to genuine success. It’s simple: people buy from people. 💥

Authenticity isn’t a strategy; it’s a way of being. Stop trying to be a version that you think people would like and expect, and start being…well…YOU.  [Catch the replay!](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/the-bianchi-law-group-llc_nothingbutthetruth-linkedin-listen-activity-7184241328103247873-Q2N5?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop)

from-resume-ecosystem-part-1-connecting-.title: From Resume to Ecosystem Part 1: Connecting, Building, and Growing Your LinkedIn Foundation
from-resume-ecosystem-part-1-connecting-.excerpt: As I reflect on how far we've come since I wrote and published 'Balance is Bullsht(https://a.co/d/0BMQng9),' in 2020, I realize that LinkedIn has morphed into so much more than a digital…
from-resume-ecosystem-part-1-connecting-.body:
As I reflect on how far we've come since I wrote and published ['Balance is Bullsh*t](https://a.co/d/0BMQng9),' in 2020, I realize that LinkedIn has morphed into so much more than a digital resume. It’s now its own thriving ecosystem where we make meaningful connections, establish thought leadership, and discover incredible opportunities.

But with the digital world moving at lightning speed, SOME of those original concepts from my book may need an update, a few things have changed since 2020, but not by much. That's why this month's Dopamine Dose newsletter is taking on a whole new form: a 2-part series based on the chapters of 'Balance is Bullsh*t' – specifically tailored to the LinkedIn terrain of 2024.

This gives me a structured way to share the latest strategies for using this powerhouse platform in our modern, AI-powered world.

Sidenote 👀: Can you believe 'Balance is Bullsh*t' came out before Ava came along? Crazy! If balance was impossible then, I don’t even know how to describe it today.

## Reinventing Connection

### Authentic Networking

Let's be real – networking isn't just about collecting connections like baseball cards. It’s about building genuine relationships. And when I think about authenticity, I am reminded of what life was like just 10 months ago when my second daughter, Ava, was a newborn. Those sleepless nights were made easier by the authentic support Rachel and I received from friends and family.This was 6 months ago; things look very different now. I’ve adapted as she’s adapted, and it’s the same with your LinkedIn presence.

Similarly, on LinkedIn, engage with your network authentically. Share your journey, insights, and value without expecting immediate returns. Studies show that professionals who actively engage with their network see a [50% increase](https://influencermarketinghub.com/linkedin-stats/) in opportunities.

### Community Building

Remember those summer weekend barbecues with family and friends? The laughter, the shared stories, the feeling of belonging? That's what building a community around your brand is all about. It's not just about another business strategy, it's about finding your people, the ones who get you, who get your vision and values. LinkedIn is your go-to platform for building this kind of community. Think of it as your digital backyard barbecue. Join groups, get into the discussions, and attend those LinkedIn events. You never know who you might meet, and the connections you make can be life-changing.Dave Gonzalez, Jaime Masters, Curt Maly, Ian Stanley, Jesse Elder, and Craig A. Handley - these friends aren’t just LinkedIn connections—they’re my chosen family.

Speaking of life-changing, you won't believe this: my wedding party? I met most of them through LinkedIn! It's a testament to how powerful those online connections can be. They turned into real-life friendships, bonds that go beyond just business. And the numbers don't lie: 60% of people on LinkedIn are part of at least one professional group. That's serious engagement, real connections, and it's not just a feeling, it's a fact.

I've personally experienced this firsthand in groups like the [Genius Network](https://www.linkedin.com/company/genius-network-/), founded by the incredible [Joe Polish](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joepolish/). It's been a wild ride – I've learned more than I thought possible, had the opportunity to speak on stage, and even landed some fantastic podcast interviews. But the best part? The incredible connections I've made, the kind that go way beyond a simple LinkedIn profile.

And let's be real, there's also the amazing business opportunities that come with it. It's a win-win situation, building a community around your brand: you find your people, you learn and grow, and you open doors to incredible opportunities. It's time to fire up the grill and get connected!I shared the mic with Les Brown and Evan Carmichael at the Genius Network Event in October 2023.

### Engagement Algorithms

It's not about sporadic bursts of activity; it's about consistent, reliable engagement. Just like my monthly date nights with Rachel build trust and intimacy, consistently sharing valuable content, engaging with others' posts, and actively participating in conversations builds your online presence and trust with the algorithm.Rachel and I in California getting our date night on.

Think of it this way: LinkedIn's algorithms love routine, just like we do. When you consistently post valuable content, comment on others' posts, and engage in discussions, you signal to the platform that you're a valuable contributor. The reward? Increased visibility, reaching a wider audience, and ultimately, achieving your LinkedIn goals.  [Recent data from 2024](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-stats/) shows that users who post consistently see a 2x increase in profile views and engagement. It's a simple formula for success, and one that can truly move you to the forefront of your industry. So, commit to a regular posting schedule, engage authentically with your network, and watch your LinkedIn profile stand out.

## Humanizing Your Brand

### Storytelling

People connect with people, not faceless keyboard warriors. Share your personal stories and experiences to humanize your brand. I often put my private life on public mode so my audience can connect with me via my personal values and struggles. Over the years I’ve had SO many people in my network reach out and tell me they’ve been moved by a particular story I shared. So don’t be afraid to open up, let your audience see the real you.

 “Stories are remembered up to 22 times more than facts alone,” [calculates Dr. Jennifer Aaker](https://womensleadership.stanford.edu/node/796/harnessing-power-stories), behavioral scientist and General Atlantic Professor and Coulter Family Fellow at the Stanford Graduate School of Business. This was a top performing post 2 months ago, and it was me getting personal but bringing it back to leadership.

Okay, so remember [that post I did](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_leadership-fatherhood-success-activity-7201229861657481216-NO_G?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) a couple of months back about me and my son hitting the pavement together? It was all about lacing up our sneakers and building that father-son bond, but it also became this unexpected leadership lesson. I mean, I'm not one to go all "Dear Diary" on social media, but there's something about sharing those relatable moments that really resonates with other folks.

The cool thing is, it tapped into this whole parent-leader vibe, especially for those of us leading Gen Z. You know, the "always-on" generation that's all about authenticity and connection. Parenting throws some curveballs at you, just like my past injury did. But, I talked about how working through that setback, even while trying to keep up with my son's energy, taught me so much about resilience and leading with empathy.

The analytics don't lie, though. This approach – keeping it personal but grounded in leadership – really clicked with people. We're talking about 3,789 impressions, 2,500 unique views, 223 likes, and 58 comments. It's proof that tapping into those shared experiences – whether it's running, parenting, or whatever challenges we're facing – can build bridges with your audience and make your leadership message way more impactful.

### Employee Advocacy

Encourage your team to share their experiences and insights on LinkedIn. This not only amplifies your brand but also showcases the human side of your business. When Rachel [shares her journey](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/my-lessons-learned-from-corporate-entrepreneurship-journey-lee-dhyve/?trackingId=gmHONV5tQJefwhf8eNMKfw%3D%3D) as my wife and business partner, it adds layers to our brand that resonate deeply with our audience. Rachel has shared her entrepreneurial and mental health journey on LinkedIn, and because of that she was featured in The Washington Post.

### Visual Content

Use videos, images, and infographics to tell your story more engagingly. Visual content is powerful in capturing attention and conveying your message. Videos are shared 20 times more than any other content on LinkedIn. So, get on that selfie mode and get behind the camera!

🔵 Use a variety of visual content types: Don't just rely on photos. Mix it up with videos, infographics, and even GIFS! (we are going to be testing GIFS out soon)

🔵 Keep it short and sweet: Attention spans are short. Aim for videos under 2 minutes and infographics with easy-to-digest information.

🔵 Use quality visuals: Make sure your images and videos are clear, well-lit, and professional.

🔵 Don't forget captions and text overlays: Provide context and key information for viewers who might not have sound turned on.

## H2H: The Future of Business

### Human-to-Human (H2H) Marketing

I’ve always talked about this, and it’s staying the same. Move beyond B2B and B2C. Focus on [H2H interactions](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/human-algorithm-how-stand-out-linkedin-create-meaningful-lee-ox8jc/?trackingId=kpp5FE8bQQyguVppqRhU6A%3D%3D). Understand the person behind the business decision and build relationships based on trust and mutual respect. Think of it like the candid heart-to-heart talk you have with a loved one. Real, honest conversations build stronger bonds.

### Empathy in Business

Show empathy in your interactions. Listen to your audience’s needs and offer support. This builds stronger, more meaningful connections. Empathy has been shown to increase customer loyalty by 30%.

### Personalization

Tailor your messages and content to address your audience's specific needs and interests. Personalized experiences foster deeper connections and loyalty. Just like how I personalize my advice for Jayden based on his unique interests and challenges, do the same for your LinkedIn connections. Being a Dad to Jayden has taught me so many leadership lessons. He's my first born.

### Embrace the NEW LinkedIn Terrain

LinkedIn is not just a professional network; it’s like a big country with its own rules, laws and social norms in which we connect, share, and grow. By embracing its full potential, you can build a powerful personal brand that stands out, create meaningful connections, and nurture real business opportunities.

Our StandOut Authority team and I are here to guide you every step of the way, helping you navigate this dynamic landscape and achieve your greatest success. Send me a DM if your brand or company needs guidance and support.

Get ready for Part 2 of my Dopamine Dose series this month! We'll dive deeper into these strategies and show you how to apply them to your LinkedIn profile for better results.

Stay human and stay connected.

🎧 Want to stand out on LinkedIn and turn connections into advocates?  Epi Ludvik had me on as guest on the BOLD Talks [Podcast](https://youtu.be/__Pbe5A0q0M?si=CA7SqK9TioI_5x-z) and that’s just one of the things we chatted about.

I shared insights on turning your profile into a magnet for high-value relationships and opportunities. Get ready to learn how to humanize your online presence and [listen to the full episode here. 🚀](https://youtu.be/__Pbe5A0q0M?si=OFzQ2Hf3lV6p4Uid)

one-simple-strategy-took-my-linkedin-fro.title: The One Simple Strategy That Took My LinkedIn From Zero To Hero
one-simple-strategy-took-my-linkedin-fro.excerpt: We all know the power of habits. They shape our days, our weeks, our lives. 30-40% of our daily actions are driven by these deep-rooted patterns. 🤯 The truly mind-blowing part? We often…
one-simple-strategy-took-my-linkedin-fro.body:
We all know the power of habits. They shape our days, our weeks, our lives. 30-40% of our daily actions are driven by these deep-rooted patterns. 🤯 The truly mind-blowing part? We often underestimate the potential for growth by simply making these routines better. Think about it: even small, seemingly insignificant tweaks can ripple outwards, creating dramatic growth over time. This same principle applies to your LinkedIn presence.

In 2006 I was at zero followers, and in 2024, I'm at 43K followers.

You might be surprised to learn that my journey from 0 followers in 2006 to over 43K+ today wasn't driven by chance. It was built on a foundation of [consistent action and habits.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/human-algorithm-how-stand-out-linkedin-create-meaningful-lee-ox8jc/?trackingId=Zm7EtFdTSlexccD4wEdgvg%3D%3D) In my 20+ years as an entrepreneur, I've learned that once I commit to creating 'winning' habits, my life and business align for success. This is especially true on LinkedIn. The platform's algorithm rewards consistent engagement, and it's why I've also managed to build a thriving newsletter with 19K+ subscribers.

Just like a daily workout builds muscle, consistent engagement on LinkedIn – posting, commenting, connecting – is the foundation for standing out and creating a strong professional network, proving that while it may sound obvious, the power of _consistency_ shouldn't be underestimated.

## Like Superman, Consistency Makes You a True LinkedIn Hero

Imagine Superman only showing up when HE feels like it… doesn’t have the same ‘superhero’ feel, right? Whether you're saving the world from evil or building your network, showing up consistently is non-negotiable. I’ve been working in the digital marketing space since the MySpace days, and I’m telling you straight up that _consistency IS 100% your best strategy for LinkedIn success.   _

Every morning, my daughter Ava expects me to be there, to give her a morning bottle and hold her. It's a daily routine that builds trust and connection between us.

Successful Fatherhood = Consistency, just like your LinkedIn presence.

I’m certain there’s non-negotiable things you do in your life day-in-day-out. On LinkedIn, [maintaining a regular posting schedule](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-success-understanding-anatomy-winning-post-joshua-b-lee-hpmoc/?trackingId=YRMTAKAKRb%2BNmDqRpHL%2FbQ%3D%3D) keeps you top-of-mind, engages your audience, and strengthens your professional relationships. And just like those morning rituals I have with my little Ava B Lee, your consistent presence on LinkedIn reassures your audience that you're reliable and worth following.

## Best Practices for LinkedIn Success

### Posting Schedule

Start by creating a posting schedule that you can stick to, no matter what. Research shows that users who post at least once a week see a 2x increase in engagement. Just like the habits Rachel B. Lee and I maintain to keep our famiLEE grounded; a consistent posting habit will help you stay aligned with your professional goals.

### Daily Engagement

Engaging with your network daily is like maintaining a friendship—if you don’t check in regularly, the bond weakens. Professionals who engage daily with their network are 35% more likely to generate opportunities. I make it a point to show up to our monthly date night, no matter how busy I get. It's a monthly touch that builds and maintains a strong connection, just like my monthly "date night" with Rachel helps us stay connected.

Committed monthly date nights are priority for Rachel and I, this is how you need to treat your LinkedIn presence.

Building a strong LinkedIn presence is about more than just posting content. It's about [actively engaging with your network,](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/beyond-numbers-game-cultivating-high-value-connections-joshua-b-lee-8nmwc/?trackingId=xlQe2Ff2RCqOYwB8fqp4xQ%3D%3D) sharing valuable insights and cultivating authentic connections. While this can feel overwhelming, with a little strategy and the right tools, it becomes manageable.

Here’s how to seamlessly integrate engagement and content creation into your daily routine:

### 1. Prioritize Engagement:

🔵 Schedule Dedicated Time: Block out 10-15 minutes once or twice a day in your calendar for engagement activities. Focus on commenting on posts, responding to messages, and sharing insightful thoughts. This dedicated time will strengthen your network and make you memorable.

🔵 Partner Up with AI for Efficiency: If crafting the perfect response feels challenging, AI can help! Use it to generate ideas and draft template messages that you can personalize with your unique voice.

Our approach at [StandOut Authority](https://www.linkedin.com/article/edit/7224063176055644162/?author=urn%3Ali%3Afs_miniProfile%3AACoAAABJssUBPwl3cL4QsEPk6ovUlOLHvqdIgOA#) is rooted in this philosophy: combining the power of AI with the human touch to create impactful content that connects with audiences.

### 2. Streamline Content Creation:

🔵 Utilize LinkedIn’s Scheduling Tool: Posting every day can be time-consuming. Schedule your content in bulk once a month to free up your time and ensure consistent posting.

🔵 Define Content Pillars: Establish 3 clear content themes that align with your brand and address your target audience's interests and challenges. This consistency makes planning easier and ensures your content resonates.

🔵 Visualize Your Vision: Having a physical reminder of your goals can be a powerful motivator. Write down your LinkedIn vision and keep it visible for daily inspiration.

### 3. Stay Ahead of the Curve:

🔵 Embrace Continuous Learning: The digital landscape is constantly evolving, so stay informed! Subscribe to relevant LinkedIn newsletters and follow industry influencers and thought leaders to keep your knowledge fresh.

### ️Tracking Your Progress

You know how gamers have those cheat sheets? Well, understanding your insights and analytics is like having a cheat sheet for your brand and business. It's all about knowing your stats so you can see what's working and what's not. Think of Tony Stark – he didn't become Iron Man overnight. He kept tinkering, adjusting, and learning from his data.

Be the Hero of your LinkedIn presence.

Tracking your performance helps you improve your strategy, just like adjusting your content marketing approach. According to LinkedIn's 2024 analytics report, users who regularly review their metrics are 40% more successful in reaching their engagement goals. That's huge! So, what's the takeaway? Use your insights to refine your LinkedIn strategy and stay ahead of the curve. You'll be surprised how much better your results will be.

## Small Actions, Big Results: Making LinkedIn a Habit for Success

In the world of LinkedIn , habit-building isn't just a strategy—it's a lifestyle. Just like the daily rituals that keep our famiLEE connected and thriving, your consistent efforts on LinkedIn will lay the foundation for long-term success.

🔵Posting regularly

🔵 Engaging with your network

🔵 Tweaking your approach based on performance data

These habits are your ticket to becoming a recognized thought leader. It’s the small, daily actions you take today that will snowball into BIG wins tomorrow. Ready to put consistency into action? Take the first step towards growing your LinkedIn presence by scheduling a post for this week! Trust me, your future self will thank you. So, get consistent, stay authentic, and watch your LinkedIn presence stand out and get noticed.

Ever feel like LinkedIn is just a sea of job postings and professional updates? I recently had the pleasure of joining Samantha Riley on her podcast, 'Influence by Design', and had a great discussion about the platform's human-to-human element that often gets overlooked! 🤝

Listen to the full episode with the link below.

We're talking:

🎧 Authentically sharing your story

🎧 Content strategies that ACTUALLY work in this AI-driven world

🎧 Taking advantage of LinkedIn's unique features to stand out from the crowd

This wasn't your typical LinkedIn conversation, be sure to check out the full episode. I'm so grateful to Samantha for having me on her show! 📢[Listen to the full episode here.](https://open.spotify.com/episode/0PNjPybPMViQjqKk6tZyZD?si=aQYP6dqiRuOOu5tZXdLNaQ)

ai-humanity-perfect-blend-success.title: AI and Humanity: The Perfect Blend for Success
ai-humanity-perfect-blend-success.excerpt: There’s no escaping AI. From over 14,700 AI startups in the US to an ecosystem of over 8 billion mobile devices equipped with AI assistants, the digital landscape is being reshaped by AI.…
ai-humanity-perfect-blend-success.body:
There’s no escaping AI. From over 14,700 AI startups in the US to an ecosystem of over 8 billion mobile devices equipped with AI assistants, the digital landscape is being reshaped by AI. In the world of business, Kodak serves as a cautionary tale of what can happen when a company fails to adapt to technological advancements.  Kodak Infographic Sourced and Credit to Powered by Scalar (2.5.9)

Once a photography giant, Eastman Kodak Company famously fell behind with the rise of digital cameras and digital photography. Despite inventing the first digital camera in 1975, Kodak struggled to capitalize on this innovation and ultimately declared bankruptcy in 2012. This serves as a stark reminder that businesses must be willing to evolve and embrace new technologies, such as AI, to stay relevant in an ever-changing market.

So, the question isn’t whether AI will play a role in your career or business, it’s how prepared you are to leverage it.

## Embracing the AI Revolution: How Technology Shapes Our Everyday Lives

AI’s presence in our daily lives is undeniable. From the moment we wake up in the morning until we head to bed at night, we subconsciously rely on AI. Think about how you set your alarm, what commands you tell Siri, Alexa, or Bixby, or even how you send messages at the crack of dawn. Voice-to-text ring any bells? Or how about as simple as using a tool to spell check and auto correct?

It’s not just about fancy gadgets or futuristic innovations anymore. AI is embedded in the very fabric of our digital interactions, from personal assistants like Siri to advanced machine learning algorithms driving business insights. Yet, despite this widespread adoption, there’s a critical element often overlooked: [the human touch](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/human-touch-how-ai-can-amplify-your-work-replace-joshua-b-lee-gbvlf/?trackingId=Ck%2FBWhH0QYKib1xNs88OiQ%3D%3D).

## The Human Element in AI

So many people ask me, “Josh, are we getting replaced by AI?” My short answer is always: NO; but – a person who uses AI the right way and leverages it as a career skill, can replace us in the long run. Here’s the good news though: AI tools are only as good as the people using them.

Take Amazon, for instance. They got hit with a lawsuit because their AI recruiting tool was actually biased against women. Turns out, the algorithm was all about favoring male candidates because it had been trained on resumes from the last decade, mostly from men. This lack of diversity not only hurt their workforce, but also put a dent in their ability to attract top talent. Source and Credit: Coin Telegraph

This whole mess just goes to show the importance of finding a sweet spot between AI automation and good ol' human instinct in the decision-making process. Sure, AI can speed things up and make life easier, but let's not forget that nothing beats good old human judgment and empathy in certain situations. By finding that balance between technology and the human touch, companies can create a workplace that's not only efficient, but also welcoming and diverse.

## The Human Element in Your Content with AI

Think about the last time ChatGPT pushed out content that you were 100% satisfied with? According to Tooltester, on average, people can correctly distinguish AI-written content from human written content 46.9% of the time. This means, almost half the time, your audience can potentially tell whether you used AI tools to write thought leadership content. And if they can tell that you’re using AI all the time, there’s a chance they might think you really don’t have a voice and you’re probably not the leader they thought you were 👀

> _AI tools are only as good as the people using them. It’s easy to get lost in the tech, but at the end of the day,_[it’s human expertise](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_content-isnt-king-anymore-quality-content-activity-7189631816117489664-_33x?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop)_that brings AI’s full potential to life. The right skills and knowledge can turn a simple tool into a powerful asset for your career and business. _

**Here are 3 tips to help you keep the human element in your content with AI: **

🔵 **1. Inject your personality**: Don't let AI completely take over your voice. Make sure to add your own personal touch, anecdotes, and unique perspective to the content generated by AI. This will help maintain authenticity and keep your audience engaged.

🔵 **2. Edit and refine:** While AI can help speed up the content creation process, it's best to review and edit the content to ensure it aligns with your brand voice and messaging. Take the time to refine the content and make it more relatable to your target audience.

🔵 **3. Collaborate with a human writer:** Consider partnering with a skilled human writer to work alongside AI tools. This collaboration can help infuse creativity, emotion, and storytelling elements that AI may lack. By combining the strengths of both human and AI, you can create content that truly resonates with your audience.

## The AI Skills Gap

In 2024, the AI skills gap is like trying to save the day without your trusty cape - you've got all the powers, but without the right skills, you can't use them to their full potential. It's like having Iron Man's suit but not knowing what each button does and how to use it. 72% of leaders believe the AI skills gap needs to be addressed, and [McKinsey](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/mckinsey-digital/our-insights/the-top-trends-in-tech#new-and-notable) agrees, stating that the lack of skilled talent is holding back AI's potential.

But hey, where there's a gap, there's an opportunity. Tech companies are itching to pay top dollar for AI-savvy leaders. This isn't just some passing fad; it's a career booster. [CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/2024/05/21/business/ai-jobs-higher-wages-productivity/index.html) even reports that mastering AI can bump up your pay by 25%. It's not just about the cash, though; it's about seizing the chance to take your success to new heights by partnering with AI, syncing with it, and making the most of its powers. Netflix and AI image source and credit: Studio Vi

Take a page from Netflix's book. They're using AI for personalized movie recommendations, content creation, and optimizing their streaming service. But guess who's calling the shots? That's right, humans! These folks have embraced AI to revolutionize how we consume media and stay ahead of the competition. And that's the kind of powerhouse move that separates the big players from the rest.

## The Economic Benefits of AI Skills

Blockbuster, once a big shot in the entertainment industry, went down in flames because they refused to adapt to the changing times. Sound familiar? It's a powerful reminder that stubbornly clinging to outdated models can lead to disaster. Just like Kodak and Blockbuster missed the boat by ignoring technological advancements, businesses that turn a blind eye to AI could end up playing catch-up to their more innovative competitors. Source and Credit: Reuters Rick Wiling United States

73% of employers are on the hunt for leaders with AI skills. Why? Because these skills are like gold, driving productivity and boosting work quality. And get this – in some fields, AI-savvy individuals are raking in salary increases of up to 40%. That's not chump change. It's not just about making more money (though that's a nice perk). It's about setting yourself up as a trailblazer who can roll with the punches, innovate, and seize the opportunities that come your way.

The digital transformation we're seeing today is just the tip of the iceberg – those armed with AI skills will not only stay relevant but will also steer the ship towards a future filled with endless possibilities.

In conclusion, still think you’re losing to AI? Think again.

YOU are the missing ingredient in the AI revolution. Don’t sleep on this opportunity because it could be the biggest mistake of your career and business. Start today. Dive into AI learning, integrate these tools into your workflow. AI is more than the next app you speak or send prompts to – it’s an enabler. It amplifies our abilities, making us more efficient and effective. But to truly utilize its power, you need to bring your A-game. You need to be a skilled professional who can turn potential into reality.

Let’s embrace AI not as a replacement but as a partner in our journey toward success. How are you integrating AI into your workflow? Share your thoughts and experiences in the comments and let’s lead this AI revolution together.

💡 Want to build real relationships with your audience and stand out in a world of automation? I had an insightful conversation on the Today’s Business Leaders podcast hosted by Gabe Arnold, where we discussed the importance of putting the human back into marketing.

From ditching cold calls and emails to creating authentic connections, I’m sharing my expertise on how to humanize your brand in the age of AI. Plus, I’m sharing a few tips on how to get the most out of your LinkedIn network by connecting with others, building your brand, and standing out with your content. Thanks for having me on as a guest Gabe, I hope to be back again.

[Tune in and check it out here!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QwBPte871aE&t=454s)****💻

human-algorithm-how-stand-out-linkedin-c.title: The Human Algorithm: How to Stand Out on LinkedIn and Create Meaningful Engagement
human-algorithm-how-stand-out-linkedin-c.excerpt: As I stood on the stage at the Archangel Academy's event in…
human-algorithm-how-stand-out-linkedin-c.body:
As I stood on the stage at the [Archangel Academy's event in Austin](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_linkedin-entrepreneurship-thoughtleadership-activity-7204482224400867328-bjEp?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) a few weeks ago, I shared my expertise on how to stand out on LinkedIn, build genuine connections, and create meaningful engagement. Being on any social media platform has its challenges, but specifically with LinkedIn. It’s not just about getting thousands of followers or likes; it's about creating meaningful relationships that create real impact. Speaking at the Archangel Event in ATX

According to recent data from LinkedIn, did you know that in the United States, about 5.7% of LinkedIn users are really active on the platform? We're talking about the heavy users who log in at least 2/3 of the time every month. You might be surprised to know that over 17 million influential leaders on LinkedIn have official accounts! This means that LinkedIn has become a go-to source for people who want to stay updated on the latest trends and insights in their industry. These thought leaders shape the conversations and direction of their respective fields, and having access to them can be really valuable. It's no wonder, then, that LinkedIn is seen as a hub for thought leadership and industry expertise.

You might be wondering how do I stand out and create meaningful connections and engagement?

> _The answer is simple: shift from quantity to quality. _

Stop sending those generic connection requests and spammy messages, create quality content, and be authentic. Let’s discuss it a little further ...

## The Human Algorithm: Why It Matters

Forget about the LinkedIn algorithm. I repeat; forget about the LinkedIn algorithm! LinkedIn is first and foremost: a professional networking app, which is why it prioritizes: THE HUMAN ALGORITHM. Behind every profile is a person with needs and emotions. Over the last 20 years, I've learned that human connection beats everything. Focus on understanding people, building trust, and creating meaningful interactions.

When was the last time you responded to a cold, robotic sales pitch? Probably never. But when someone genuinely engages with you, shares valuable insights, and shows they care, you pay attention. It's the same on LinkedIn. Treat each interaction and post you make as if you're meeting someone face-to-face. Be real, be human, and show genuine interest in the person.

Think about it like dating. You don't go on a first date, propose to someone on the spot, and expect them to say yes. No, you build a relationship, get to know them, and show genuine interest in their interests and values. It's the same on LinkedIn when you’re thinking about your content and connections.

## The Power of Personalized Connection Requests

Mass connection requests don’t work. Instead, use LinkedIn’s advanced search to find people who align with your goals. Send personalized connection requests and explain why you want to connect. This small step makes a huge difference and sets you apart from the spam.

When I started using LinkedIn's advanced search, it was a game-changer. I wasn't just connecting with random people; I was finding those who shared my interests, values, and goals. This targeted approach not only grew my network but also led to meaningful collaborations and opportunities, just like the one I got for the Archangel event.

[Treat connection requests with a dating mindset](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/beyond-numbers-game-cultivating-high-value-connections-joshua-b-lee-8nmwc/?trackingId=6I%2BetLBISyqsGwmCPAwkJA%3D%3D). No one really goes on a first date, key to their home on hand, ready to say “Hey, you seem cool! Let’s move in!” You can’t go from 0 to marriage straight away. Treat using LinkedIn the same way. Look at their profiles, visit their posts, and engage genuinely. Warm them up and show real interest in what they have to say. Just for kicks, here’s Rachel and I in 2016 in our early dating relationship journey; she definitely wasn’t moving in with me on Day 1.

So, next time you're sending a connection request, remember it's not just about adding someone to your network. It's about [building a relationship and showing genuine interest](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_linkedin-contentcreation-contentstrategy-activity-7198329154725978112-733N?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) in the person. Explain why you want to connect and personalize your request. Don’t be surprised when people start responding, conversations begin to happen, real connections are made, and opportunities are created.

## The Power of Thought Leadership Content

I'm guessing you're tired of drowning in a sea of meaningless content in your feed, right? I mean, with 2.5 hours per day spent on social media, it's like we're all trying to find connection, but nothing sticks. But here's the thing: not everyone's adding value to the conversation.

> _Everyone's posting, but not everyone's adding value._

As a thought leader, you're not just trying to make noise on LinkedIn – you're trying to create content that sparks conversations, makes people want to come back for more, and (dare I say it?) makes you stand out from the crowd.

So, how do you do it? You focus on what your audience cares about, and you deliver insights that make them go, "Damn, I needed to hear that!" Create high-quality content that showcases your expertise, shares your personal story, and lets your personality shine through. I mean, I used to just post for the sake of posting, but when I shifted my focus to [creating content that resonated](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-success-understanding-anatomy-winning-post-joshua-b-lee-hpmoc/?trackingId=6vQrLqMwRNmj0TOsc2MKfg%3D%3D) with my audience, engagement and connections went through the roof.

I looked up my most popular Dopamine Dose Newsletter to date from January 2024 till June 2024, and guess what it is? 👇 This is my most popular Dopamine Dose Newsletter as of 2024 (YTD Jan 2024 - June 2024)

It’s my [Beyond the Numbers Game: Cultivating High-Value Connections for LinkedIn Success](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_dopaminedose-linkedin-networking-activity-7176223457423110144-6Kpf?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) edition. It got 7,075 impressions, 400 likes, and 113 comments. Why do you think that is? People are looking for solutions, value, and thought leadership. They want to feel like someone cares about their overall goals.

Then I looked up my most popular post YTD January 2024 – June 2024 and it’s an edition of my [Dopamine Dealer Newsletter from 6 months ago](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_linkedin-dopaminedose-marketing-activity-7142898967549231105-BVq3?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop). 👇 This is my TOP post so far from January 2024 - June 2024 YTD

Here’s what’s interesting. It had less likes and comments than my top newsletter edition, but it had way higher impressions and reach which made it my #1 post YTD. (Jan 2024 – June 2024) It had 146 likes, 71 comments, and 2 reposts. But the impressions were 7,444.

_Just as a refresher: On LinkedIn, impressions are the number of times your posts, updates, or profile are viewed by others. Think of it like how many people are looking at your stuff. Reach, on the other hand, is how many unique people are seeing your posts. For example, if 100 people see your post, but 20 people see it multiple times, your reach is 100, but your impressions are 120. Got it? _

Why does this matter and what does it mean? Generally speaking, if your post's got low engagement but high impressions and reach, it's a sign you're building a strong brand and establishing yourself as a thought leader, even if the engagement numbers don't match. Focus on creating high-quality content that adds value and sparks conversations, and you'll likely reach a wider audience, even if it doesn't always translate to immediate likes and comments.

### 3 Tips to Keep in Mind for Your Content:

🔵 Be Bold and Authentic:

Dare to be different and stand out from the crowd. Share your personal story, showcase your expertise, and let your personality shine through. This is where the magic happens, and you'll start to inspire and influence others.

🔵 Focus on Strategy Over Quantity:

It's not about posting for the sake of posting. Instead, focus on creating a consistent and intentional content strategy that showcases your unique value proposition. This will help you stand out and build a loyal following.

🔵 Measure Success by Engagement, Not Just Likes:

While likes and comments are important metrics, don't just focus on the numbers. Instead, measure the quality of your engagement, including the depth of conversations, the relevance of your content, and the impact it's having on your audience. This will help you refine your strategy and continue to inspire and influence others.

## The Power of Authenticity: Don't Be a Fake

In a world full of fake promotional content, authenticity wins. If I’m being honest, my best-performing posts for engagement and comments are about my family, personal life, and mental wellness. It's because people can tell when I'm being genuine, and that I'm not just a CEO, Dopamine Dealer of LinkedIn, or the Top AI LinkedIn Voice. I'm a dad, a husband, and a human being that likes to connect with other human beings. People are tired of being sold to - they want real interactions.

The post that performed in 3rd place for the year (YTD January 2024 – June 2024) was [my post about my daughter Skylar and Dyslexic Thinking.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_dyslexicthinking-dyslexia-linkedin-activity-7146160384071065600-bRJd?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop)  My daughter Skylar and I

Show who you are, not just what you do. Share your journey, successes and failures. This builds trust and makes people more likely to engage with you. Entrepreneur Magazine put out a [great article](https://www.entrepreneur.com/science-technology/with-this-linkedin-algorithm-change-your-best-posts-could/470219) and reported that Dan Roth, LinkedIn's editor in chief discussed that “LinkedIn takes a very different view on the value of "reach." The company's goal is to "connect the world's professionals to economic opportunity," but in their eyes, that doesn't usually mean reaching the largest number of other professionals. Instead, they want to help users connect to the few people in their industry who can make a meaningful difference.”

I used to think I had to present a perfect image online. But the more I shared my real experiences – the highs and the lows – the more people connected with me. Authenticity is powerful. It builds trust and encourages genuine interactions. LinkedIn is more than just a social network. It’s a powerhouse for building genuine, high-value relationships. Focus on real engagement, understand the human algorithm, and stay authentic.

Which strategy will you implement first to shift your LinkedIn approach from quantity to quality? Share your thoughts below and if you’re struggling, send me a DM.

**Curious about commanding attention on Linkedin?**Dive into our Standout Authority Experience! One of our modules is all about becoming an authority and standing out in your niche. We take you through the steps to get a clear vision for your personal brand, content, and LinkedIn strategy so that you have a rock-solid plan that gets you seen, heard and paid consistently.Dive into our Standout Authority Experience!

BUT above all else, the Standout Authority Experience will give you the confidence to finally get VISIBILITY and BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES without having to SPAM and SELL people.

**😎**[Get all the deets right here.](https://standoutauthority.com/standout-authority-experience-on-demand/)

navigating-entrepreneurial-challenges-gu.title: Navigating Entrepreneurial Challenges: A Guide on Turning Sh*t Moments to Success
navigating-entrepreneurial-challenges-gu.excerpt: These 3 words cost my company $1.3M and slashed $9M more off our revenue: “I RAISE YOU”. What happens when you’re in Vegas, coupled with a ton of drinks at the Playboy Club? DISASTER. Yes,…
navigating-entrepreneurial-challenges-gu.body:
These 3 words cost my company $1.3M and slashed $9M more off our revenue: “I RAISE YOU”. What happens when you’re in Vegas, coupled with a ton of drinks at the Playboy Club? DISASTER. Yes, that was me, thinking I was invincible and about to win a bet—and of course, life being funny that way threw me a curve ball—$1.3M worth, at that.

Back when this happened, it felt like the end of the world, and all I could blame was myself. In hindsight, I knew this was the kick in the butt I needed to get my sh*t sorted, and boy, it was a good, hard kick indeed.

In this edition of Dopamine Dose, I’m going to dive into the biggest mistakes most entrepreneurs make and how to avoid exactly what I did in the past—so you don’t end up getting sh*t faced drunk, betting $1.3M, and almost losing your company.

## Mistake #1: Lack of Clear Vision

Finding your vision can be tough, but it’s your north star. I remember when I met Sir [Richard Branson](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rbranson?miniProfileUrn=urn%3Ali%3Afs_miniProfile%3AACoAAAwp1RMBxG26M3Qkhm4klqLNr1bIplo6GhY) on Necker Island. It was a trip with my peer group, Maverick1000, an invite-only network of entrepreneurs. Our flight there was nerve-wracking—imagine a tiny plane with a door that wouldn’t close! But the real lesson came from watching Richard in action.

Richard’s approach to vision was eye-opening. We first met him on Mosquito Island, where he casually pitched his vision for the island’s future. His clarity and ability to see opportunities were incredible.

> _It wasn’t just about making money; it was about creating something bigger—a community._
Richard Branson and I

This experience made me realize the power of having a clear vision. Before this, I was just going through the motions in my business. I was focused on daily operations and profits but lacked a clear direction. This is a common mistake many entrepreneurs make—not having a clear vision. Without it, you’re just spinning your wheels without a real sense of purpose or direction.

🔵 Start by understanding your pain and your “why.”

🔵 Journal your thoughts, answer key questions about your goals, and regularly revisit your answers. Key questions to get you started: What do you want to create in your life? When you visualize the future, what do you feel? What results will you achieve? How will you bring your vision to life?

Remember, a clear vision is the foundation of achieving fulfillment and leaving a legacy. It’s what separates merely running a business for profit from [building something meaningful and impactful](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_dopaminedealer-success-fatherhood-activity-7170440359800496129-2kao?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop).

## Mistake #2: Neglecting Personal Health and Well-being

Obesity and weight issues are prevalent in the United States, where almost 41.9% of U.S. adults are obese. Beyond vanity and looking good, it’s important to stay healthy because your physical health can relate to your mental health. Running a successful business means being able to take care of yourself AND the people who rely on you; the only way to do so is by being [holistically healthy in mind and body.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_leadership-mentalwellness-entrepreneurlife-activity-7186009668681392128-ULe6?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop)

Entrepreneurs often push their health aside, focusing solely on business. I learned this the hard way. I was conducting business as usual, but my health had plummeted, and I didn’t even realize how far I’d fallen. My energy was low, and I felt lazy. Back then, I believed I needed to support my family 100% no matter the cost, looking back, I regret not prioritizing my health and energy. First time Dad and stuck in the mindset that I needed to handle it all2009 and thinking I had it under control

I remember looking at old photos and wondering, “Why didn’t I maintain my health?” I had let my business drive my life, a trap many entrepreneurs fall into. It’s like running a car on one wheel—you need all four cylinders to move forward. The turning point came when I started taking Pilates classes. It slimmed me down and reignited my energy. I realized that staying physically active was one of the pieces of the success puzzle. Competing in races like Spartans and Tough Mudders fueled my competitive spirit and kept me healthy.

Today, I enjoy working out outdoors, using Peloton, or hitting the gym with my son Jayden. Remember, physical energy boosts creative energy, which is essential for any entrepreneur. Don’t make the mistake of neglecting your health. Balance your work with physical activities and set realistic fitness goals. Incorporate short, daily workouts to stay energized and productive.

💥 A healthy body supports a healthy business. Happy, healthy and much smarter as a Dad of 3. Ava is 9 months old now, I want to be around for all 3 of my kids for a long time.

## Mistake #3: Financial Mismanagement

I save this story for last, because I think, as shocking as it was—it was one of the most pivotal moments in my life that I’ll never forget. Once in Vegas, I bet $1.3 million on a business deal after some drinks. It looked like a sure win that would skyrocket my profits, but I hadn’t done my homework. That deal ended up nearly ruining my business, dropping our revenue from $10 million a year to just $1 million. The financial fallout was brutal, leading to sleepless nights and legal battles.

I had to decide whether to chase the $100,000 needed for legal fees or focus on rebuilding. Ultimately, I chose to rebuild, learning a hard lesson about the importance of due diligence and sound financial decisions. As I reflect on that experience, I realize it was a tipping point that led me to become more centered and successful in all aspects of life. To paraphrase Warren Buffett, mistakes are the best way to learn, especially when you learn from the mistakes of others. _ _ Awesome quote from Warren Buffett

This experience taught me that, as entrepreneurs, no matter what, you’ve got to keep your finances in check, even if you’re at the height of your career and business. 82% of small businesses fail because of cash flow issues, every business decision has an impact on your finances. After all, cash is the bloodline of any business, and without it? You’re running a hobby—not a company.

## There Is a Light at the End of the Tunnel

Rash decisions can have a devastating impact on YOU and your team/employees. If there’s one thing, I’d like for you to take away from this, it is **that mistakes are our best teachers**_._ Yep, it’s a cliché and it’s overused: but with good reason.

> _This whole journey of running a business isn’t linear, and it sure as hell isn’t black and white. _

But it’s in these moments where we make mistakes that we can either give up and throw in the towel or look at life from a different lens. Surprise yourself with how much resilience and problem-solving you’re capable of. Rising above is when you get to learn about yourself the most! What are some of your biggest mistakes as an entrepreneur and what did you learn from it? Share your experiences in the comments, you never know who you’re going to help 👇

🔵 Understand the role of personal branding on LinkedIn

human-touch-how-ai-can-amplify-your-work.title: The Human Touch: How AI Can Amplify Your Work, Not Replace It
human-touch-how-ai-can-amplify-your-work.excerpt: It's only been one year since AI started transforming the workplace, and already it's clear that it's not just about having the technology, but also navigating its complexities and…
human-touch-how-ai-can-amplify-your-work.body:
It's only been one year since AI started transforming the workplace, and already it's clear that it's not just about having the technology, but also navigating its complexities and maximizing its benefits. AI has already begun to reshape the way [we work](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_content-isnt-king-anymore-quality-content-activity-7189631816117489664-_33x?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop), lead, and hire, with significant implications for the future of the workplace. So, what does this shift mean for the future of work, and how can we adapt to the present?

### Beyond Productivity: The Impact of AI in the Workplace

According to Microsoft’s [2024 Work Trend Index](https://news.microsoft.com/en-cee/2024/05/13/microsoft-and-linkedin-released-2024-work-trend-index-three-out-of-four-people-use-ai-at-work/), 90% of users say AI saves them time, while 84% feel it makes them more creative. By handling repetitive tasks, AI frees up employee time for more meaningful work. This shift helps reduce burnout and improves job satisfaction.

The company who gets it is IBM. Founded back in 1911, this company has consistently pushed the boundaries of innovation, and today, they're a force to be reckoned with in the world of AI. With a focus on enterprise-led solutions, cloud computing, and AI consulting, they're constantly driving progress going beyond just using AI for productivity.  IBM and AI - Sourced from IBM

Some specific examples of how IBM has implemented AI to help its employees:

🔵 Watson Assistant: IBM's Watson Assistant is an AI-powered chatbot that helps employees answer common questions and complete tasks, freeing up time for more complex and creative work.

🔵 Automated reporting: IBM has automated reporting tasks, such as generating sales reports and customer databases, using AI-powered tools like Watson Studio.

🔵 Intelligent process automation: IBM has implemented intelligent process automation. (IPA) to automate repetitive tasks, such as data entry and document processing, using AI-powered tools like IBM Watson Business.

Did you know that at the start of 2024, IBM was reported to hold the most generative AI patents? That's no small feat. In 2023, they filed over 1,500 patent applications. It's a testament to their dedication to advancing the field of AI.

What's exciting to me is the potential for AI to transform industries and drive meaningful change. I hope to see more companies implementing AI to better the work lives of their employees the way IBM has done.

### Smarter Workforce, Better Outcomes: AI Empowers Employees and Leaders

[AI isn't replacing jobs](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_dopaminedose-dopaminedealer-linkedin-activity-7186370332386103297-q7Te?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop)—it's enhancing them. 60% of leaders worry their organization’s leadership lacks a plan and vision to implement AI. Take Microsoft, for example, led by the visionary Satya Nadella. As one of the original disruptors of the digital revolution, Microsoft has always been about empowering people and businesses to achieve more. They believe technology has the power to transform lives, and that AI is a key driver of that transformation.

In fact, they're so committed to this vision that they've made massive investments in AI research, including their 49% stake in OpenAI.

But what really sets Microsoft apart is their commitment to AI equity. They believe that access to this technology shouldn't be limited to a select few, which is why they've pioneered initiatives to educate and upskill workforces around the world.  Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella

Microsoft just dropped some major updates to its Copilot tool for Microsoft 365. This tech is all about leveling up your AI skills, making it easier for you to complete tasks and get stuff done.

LinkedIn has been making some serious strides lately, and one of the most notable moves is their decision to offer a range of [free online courses](https://www.linkedin.com/business/talent/blog/learning-and-development/new-framework-for-ai-upskilling?trk=microsoft-li-wti-release) to their [premium subscribers](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joshuablee_check-out-some-of-the-new-ai-features-on-activity-7183108831760056320-E1-N?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop). These bite-sized modules are designed to help professionals from all backgrounds brush up on their skills and knowledge in AI-related fields. I think it's cool they're taking this approach, because it's not just about giving people access to information but also giving them the tools to improve their skills and stay competitive in the job market.

It's clear these developments are sending a powerful message: AI is no longer the exclusive domain of experts. It's a vital tool that can be adapted to serve a wide range of industries and professionals.

> _It's all about leveling the playing field and creating a brighter future for everyone._

This means that people from all backgrounds and with varying levels of resources can now explore and develop AI technologies, which will ultimately lead to a more innovative and promising future. It's like everyone gets to play with the same tools and has the same opportunities to create something new and exciting 😀

### Human Touch Required: What AI Can't Do Alone

AI is a powerful tool, but it’s the human element that drives success. Digital marketing expert Neil Patel observed that content written by humans pulls in 5x more traffic than what's written by AI alone. This proves that relying solely on tools like ChatGPT, Jasper, Claude, and many more can result in bland and uninspiring content. Sourced NP Digital

According to Gallup, [70% of our decisions](https://www.gallup.com/workplace/398954/customer-brand-preference-decisions-gallup-principle.aspx), including which brands we prefer, are based on emotional factors. That's crazy, right? Emotions are a big part of being human, and AI can't feel those emotions like we do. Instead of using artificial intelligence to crank out generic content, using our own experiences and emotions can make our writing more relatable and authentic. And let's be real, AI-generated content often feels flat and lackluster.

But, when we use AI wisely and know when to use it, we can create something truly special that connects us as humans. Here's my take:

🔵 Merge your human creativity with AI efficiency

🔵 Use AI tools to spark new ideas, organize thoughts, and fine-tune details, but the REAL voice and direction should come from you, 100% handcrafted, and human written

This is why our approach at StandOut Authority is so effective. [We blend AI’s capabilities with human creativity](https://standoutauthority.com/training/) and intuition to produce high-quality content that connects with our audience.

### Enhancing Collaboration with AI

AI can significantly enhance collaboration within teams. Tools like Microsoft Teams (which we personally use at SOA) and Slack now integrates AI to streamline communication and project management. Integrating AI into your workflow can seem daunting. Start small. Use AI for specific tasks and gradually expand its role. Focus on areas where AI can save time and enhance productivity. And remember, it’s about complementing your work, NOT replacing it.

🔵 64% of business owners think AI will help improve customer interactions and build stronger relationships.

🔵 64% believe AI will help streamline tasks and free up time for more important things.

🔵 60% of respondents think AI will give them a competitive edge and drive sales growth.

I feel like those stats speak clearly that AI can help in a variety of ways for business. Think of it as the Avengers assembling—everyone brings their best to tackle the mission together.

AI is here to stay, but it doesn’t mean it’s taking over the world and our jobs, or that it’ll be the end of our livelihood. It’s transforming how we work and how it opens our organizations up to endless possibilities. But to get the most out of AI, we need to use it wisely. Treat it as an assistant, not a crutch. Embrace its potential, but always keep the human element at the forefront.

This approach will help us nurture the true power of AI and create a more productive, innovative workplace. Let’s use AI to amplify our strengths and make our work even better. How are you integrating AI into your workflow? Share your thoughts and experiences below!

Plus, I’m sharing a few tips on how to get the most out of your LinkedIn network by connecting with others, building your brand, and standing out with your content.

Thanks for having me on as a guest Gabe, I hope to be back again.
